description: A small, quadrupedal reptilian creature with teal-green skin and darker patches. It has large, red eyes, a wide mouth, and small, pointed ears. A prominent, green plant bulb is fused to its back.
A medium-sized, quadrupedal reptilian creature. Its teal skin is slightly darker. The bulb on its back has bloomed into a pink flower bud with large green leaves at its base.

A large, heavy-set quadrupedal creature with bumpy, bluish-green skin. The bud on its back has fully bloomed into a giant, pink, multi-petaled flower with a white-spotted pattern, supported by a thick, trunk-like stem.
A small, bipedal lizard-like creature with orange skin and a cream-colored underbelly. It has sharp claws, blue eyes, and a single flame burning at the tip of its long, thin tail.

A bipedal, reptilian creature with a darker, reddish-orange skin tone. It has a longer snout, more pronounced claws, and a single, sharp horn-like protrusion on the back of its head. The flame on its tail is larger.

A large, bipedal, draconic creature with orange skin and a cream-colored belly. It has a long neck, two large leathery wings with teal-green undersides, two horns on its head, and a powerful tail with a large flame at its tip.
A small, bipedal turtle with light-blue skin. It has a brown shell with a pale-yellow underside and a white, ridged border. It has large, brown eyes and a short, curled tail.
A medium-sized, bipedal turtle with a deeper blue skin tone. It has two prominent, feathery white ears. Its brown shell is well-worn, and its tail is now large, white, and fluffy.
A large, bipedal turtle with a massive, dark brown shell. Two large, silver water cannons protrude from the front of its shell, over its shoulders. It has a stocky blue body and a triangular jaw.
A small, green caterpillar with a smooth body. It has large, black, circular eyes, a yellow, Y-shaped antenna on its head, and multiple pairs of small, pink, suction-cup-like feet.
A green, chrysalis-like creature. It is a hardened, crescent-shaped green shell with two large, white eye-like markings on the front, giving it a half-asleep appearance.
A large, lepidopteran creature with a purple, segmented body and thin blue limbs. It has huge, white wings with black veining, two large, red compound eyes, and long, purple antennae.
A small, hairy caterpillar with a brown body and a cream-colored face. It has a small, pink, horn-like stinger on its head and another on its tail. It has large, black eyes.
A yellow, cocoon-like creature, segmented and dome-shaped at the top. It has a hardened shell and large, black eye-markings. A sharp, metallic-looking stinger protrudes from its front.

A large, wasp-like insectoid creature with a yellow, segmented body and black stripes. It has two pairs of veined, transparent wings, large, red compound eyes, and two massive, silver, drill-like stingers on its forelegs.
A small, plump bird with brown feathers on its back and a cream-colored underbelly. It has a short, sharp beak, small black eyes, and pink feet. The feathers on its head are messy.
A medium-sized bird of prey with a sharp, hooked beak and piercing eyes. It has shaggy, brown feathers and a prominent crest on its head with red plumes.
A very large, predatory bird with massive wings. It has a large, sharp crest of pinkish-red feathers, shaggy brown plumage, a powerful, hooked beak and strong talons.
A small, quadrupedal rodent with purple fur, large red eyes, and a cream-colored underbelly. It has very large front incisors and long whiskers. Its tail is long and curled at the tip.
A large, bipedal rodent with coarse, brown fur on its back and light-tan fur on its belly. It stands on its powerful hind legs, has sharp claws, large incisors, and long, sensitive whiskers.
A small, avian creature with a scruffy, brown-feathered body. It has a long, sharp beak for pecking and short, reddish wings. It has three spiky feathers on its head and piercing red eyes.
A large, vulture-like bird with a very long neck and a sharp, spear-like beak. It has massive, broad brown wings and a bald, pinkish head.

A long, serpentine creature with a purple, scaled body. Its underbelly is yellow and segmented. It has large, yellow, slit-pupil eyes and a wide mouth. A yellow, rattle-like fin is on the end of its tail.
A very large, purple cobra with a massive, spread hood. The hood has an intimidating, face-like pattern on it. It has a sleek, powerful body, sharp fangs, and piercing red eyes.
A small, bipedal rodent-like creature with bright yellow fur. It has long, black-tipped ears, two round red pouches on its cheeks, and a long, lightning-bolt shaped tail.

An orange, bipedal rodent, larger and plumper than its pre-evolution. It has a small patch of white fur on its belly. Its ears are smaller and mostly brown, and it has a long, thin tail ending in a large, orange, leaf-shaped tip.
A bipedal creature with a body covered in tough, yellow, brick-patterned plates. It has long, sharp black claws, a pointed snout, and blue eyes.
A large, bipedal creature covered in thick, sharp brown quills that protrude from its back. It has long, powerful claws for digging and a tan underbelly.
A small, quadrupedal creature with light blue skin and darker blue spots. It has large, red eyes, prominent front teeth, and large, sensitive ears. Small, poisonous barbs cover its back.
A medium-sized, bipedal creature with tough, light-blue scales. It has larger ears, a more powerful build, and a small horn on its forehead. A row of toxic spines runs down its back.

A large, bipedal creature covered in hard, steel-like blue scales. It is a powerful, bulky monster with a large horn on its snout and a thick, powerful tail. A series of large, venomous spines runs along its spine.
A small, quadrupedal creature with purple-pink skin and darker spots. It has large, spiky ears, red eyes, and a small horn on its forehead. Large, venomous spines run down its back.
A medium-sized, bipedal creature with a tough, purple hide. Its horn is larger and the spines on its back are bigger and more toxic. It has an aggressive stance.
A massive, bipedal reptilian monster with a thick, dark purple armored hide. It has a huge, powerful horn on its forehead, a stocky build with a thick tail, and large, sharp claws.
A small, bipedal creature with a star-shaped body and pink skin. It has short, stubby limbs, two small wings on its back, and a cute face. It has a single, curled hair on its head.
A larger, bipedal creature with a stout, pink body and a pointed snout. It has larger wings on its back and possesses long, pointed ears with brown tips. It has a large, claw-like nail on each hand.
A small, quadrupedal fox-like creature with reddish-brown fur. It has a cream-colored, fluffy crest of fur on its head and six long, orange, curled tails with darker tips.
A large, elegant, quadrupedal fox with sleek, golden-white fur. It has nine long, flowing tails, each tipped with a golden-orange color. It has a slender body and piercing red eyes.
A pink, spherical creature with a rubbery texture. It has very short, stubby arms, large pointed ears with black insides, and huge, blue eyes. It has a small tuft of curled fur on its forehead.
A large, pink, balloon-like bipedal creature with a soft, rubbery body. It has long, rabbit-like ears, large blue eyes, and a signature curl of fur on its forehead.
A small, blue, bat-like creature with a round body. It has no visible eyes, a mouth full of small fangs, and massive, purple, triangular ears. Its legs are thin and spindly.

A large, blue bat with a furry body. Its mouth is almost always open, revealing fangs. Its purple wings are huge, and its ears are smaller relative to its body, but still large. It has developed a pair of small, black eyes.
A small, plant-like creature that walks on two root-like feet. Its body is dark blue with red, circular eyes. A clump of five long, green leaves grows from the top of its head.
A bipedal, plant-like creature with blue skin. It has a drool of sweet-smelling nectar leaking from its mouth. The leaves on its head have sprouted a single, round, red-and-white-spotted flower bud.
A bipedal creature with a blue body. On its head sits a huge, red, multi-petaled flower with large, white spots. The flower's petals are heavy, causing its head to droop.
A small, orange, insect-like creature with a large, mushroom-like fungus growing on its back. It has six small legs, and large, white, pupil-less eyes. The mushroom has red and yellow spots.
A larger, orange, crab-like insectoid. The mushroom on its back has completely taken over its body, becoming a single, massive, red-and-yellow-spotted fungus. The creature's eyes are blank and white.
A small, round, furry creature with a purple body. It has large, red compound eyes, a small horn on its head, and two small fangs. It is covered in a fine, fuzzy purple fur.

A large, moth-like insectoid with a light-purple body. It has massive, dusty, lavender-colored wings with complex patterns. Its eyes are huge and compound, and it has a pair of long, feathery antennae.
A simple, brown, mole-like creature with a large, pink nose. It is mostly subterranean, with only its head and upper body visible. It has small, black eyes.
Three identical, brown, mole-like creatures with large pink noses, joined together at their base. They move in unison, emerging from and burrowing into the ground with great speed.
A small, feline creature with sleek, cream-colored fur. It has a small, black-tipped ears, long whiskers, and a golden, coin-like charm embedded in its forehead.
A tall, slender, bipedal feline creature with cream-colored fur. It is elegant and poised, with a long, coiled tail. The golden charm on its forehead is now larger and more prominent.
A yellow, bipedal creature resembling a duck or a platypus. It has a wide, flat bill, vacant-looking eyes with tiny pupils, and three strands of black hair on its head.
A large, blue, bipedal creature resembling a duck or platypus. It has a powerful build, a sharp, red gem on its forehead, and webbed hands with long, sharp claws.
A bipedal, pig-like primate with a spherical, hairy brown body. It has a pink, pig-like snout, triangular ears, and walks on two powerful legs. It has a coiled tail.
A large, bipedal ape-like creature with shaggy, off-white fur. It has a pig-like nose, and wears black, metallic-looking bands on its wrists and ankles. It has a powerful, muscular build.
A quadrupedal, canine-like creature with orange fur and black stripes. It has a shaggy, cream-colored mane covering its chest and head, and a fluffy, cream-colored tail.
A very large, majestic, canine creature with orange fur and striking black stripes. It has a long, flowing mane of cream-colored fur that billows as it runs. It has a powerful and noble appearance.
A small, spherical, tadpole-like creature with blue skin. It has a long, thin tail with a translucent fin. It has large, hypnotic, black-and-white spiral pattern on its belly.
A bipedal, tadpole-like creature that has grown arms. It has a smooth, blue-black body, a spherical shape, and wears white gloves on its hands. The hypnotic spiral remains on its belly.

A large, bipedal frog-like creature with a powerful, athletic build. It is mostly blue and white, with thick muscles. The hypnotic spiral on its belly is still present. It wears white, glove-like markings on its hands.
A small, bipedal creature with a yellow, humanoid body. It has a large head, closed, fox-like eyes, and a thick, brown tail. It is often seen holding a silver spoon.

A humanoid creature with a segmented, brown, armor-like torso and a large, yellow head. It has long, pointed ears, a mustache-like growth, and two long brown pauldrons on its shoulders. It holds two silver spoons.

A tall, slender, humanoid creature with a yellow and brown body. It has a very long, drooping mustache, pointed ears, and a sleek, agile form. It wields two large, silver spoons as psychic amplifiers.
A gray, bipedal, humanoid creature with four powerful arms and a muscular body. It has a reptilian head with red eyes and bony ridges on its forehead. It wears a black, brief-like garment.
A larger, more muscular version of its pre-evolution. It is a four-armed, gray, humanoid creature with more defined muscles, bony crests on its head, and a powerful, intimidating presence.

A massive, four-armed, gray-skinned humanoid monster. Its muscles are incredibly large and defined. It has a reptilian face with red eyes and prominent ridges. It wears a golden, championship-like belt.
A small, plant-like creature with a flexible, brown stem for a body. It has two green leaves for arms and a large, yellow, bell-shaped mouth for a head.
A plant-like creature resembling a pitcher plant. It has a yellow, bell-shaped body with green spots, leafy arms, and a vine-like tendril extending from its head. A large, gaping mouth is at the top.
A large, yellow pitcher plant with a huge, gaping mouth lined with sharp teeth. It has large, leaf-like arms and a long, flexible green vine on its head. It is rooted to the ground.
A blue, jellyfish-like creature with two long, stinging tentacles. It has a translucent, dome-shaped bell and two large, red, crystalline orbs on its body.
A massive, jellyfish-like creature with a spiky, blue-and-white bell. It has numerous long, venomous tentacles and a pair of large, red, jewel-like orbs. Its appearance is menacing and formidable.
A floating, spherical rock with two muscular arms. It has a rugged, gray, stone body and a perpetually angry facial expression with furrowed brows and a frowning mouth.
A larger, more defined creature made of rock. It has a boulder-like body, two main arms, and a smaller, secondary pair of arms. Its rocky form is more chiseled and detailed.
A massive, vaguely humanoid creature made of dark gray boulders. It has a large, craggy body, four arms, and a reptilian head made of stone. Its lower body is a single, large boulder.
A quadrupedal, equine creature with cream-colored fur. Its mane and tail are made of bright, flickering flames. It has a single, small horn on its forehead and powerful legs.
A large, powerful, unicorn-like horse with a cream-colored coat. Its mane and tail are a roaring blaze of fire. It has a single, prominent, sharp horn on its forehead.
A pink, dim-witted, quadrupedal creature with a dopey, vacant expression. It has a long, cream-colored snout and a tail with a cream-colored tip. It is often seen near water.

A bipedal creature formed when a Shellder bites a Slowpoke's tail. It's a pink, dopey creature walking on two legs, with a large, spiral-shaped, gray shell permanently attached to its tail, forcing it to stand upright.
A mechanical, spherical creature made of gray metal. It has a single, large central eye, and two horseshoe magnets on its sides that function as arms. A large screw is on top of its head.
Three Magnemite joined together by a strong magnetic force. It consists of three metallic spheres, each with its own eye and magnets, forming a triangular or linear cluster.
A brown, duck-like bird with a short, blunt beak. It is always seen carrying a green leek or spring onion, which it uses as a tool or weapon. It has a distinctive V-shaped mark on its forehead.
A brown, two-headed, ostrich-like bird. It has two long necks, each with its own head and brain. It has shaggy brown feathers and powerful, two-toed legs.
A three-headed, ostrich-like bird. It has a shaggy, brown-feathered body and three long necks, each topped with a head that has a sharp beak and angry red eyes.
A white, pinniped-like creature with a smooth, sleek body. It has a small horn on its forehead, a cat-like face with whiskers, and a fin-like tail. It is covered in thick, white fur.
A large, white, sea lion-like creature. It has a graceful, serpentine body and a prominent, sharp horn on its forehead. Its fur is pure white, and it has a powerful, elegant presence.
A purple, amorphous blob of sludge. It has a large, gaping mouth and two large, white eyes with small black pupils. It lacks any defined shape and constantly oozes.

A massive, amorphous pile of purple sludge with a grotesque, wide-open mouth. Several toxic, skull-and-crossbones-like markings appear on its body. It has long, sludge-like arms and a pair of large, menacing eyes.
A bivalve mollusk with a hard, purple, spiky shell. A small, black, pearl-like creature with two beady eyes is visible inside when the shell is open. Its tongue is always lolling out.

A menacing, black, bivalve creature encased in a formidable, jagged, gray shell covered in sharp spikes. It has a pair of angry, horn-like protrusions and two piercing eyes visible from within its spiky armor.
A spherical, floating creature made of purple gas. It has a mischievous, grinning face with large, white eyes and two fanged teeth. It is surrounded by a hazy, purple aura.
A dark purple, ghostly creature with a long tongue and a sinister grin. It has a spiky, ethereal body and detached, three-fingered hands that float in front of it.
A bipedal, shadowy creature with a roundish body and short, pointed limbs. It has spiky fur on its back, glowing red eyes, and a wide, sinister grin that stretches across its face.
A colossal creature composed of a series of gigantic, interconnected gray boulders, forming a massive serpentine body. It has a rugged, rocky head with a prominent jaw and deep-set eyes.
A stout, bipedal creature with a yellow body and a long, trunk-like nose. It has a brown, triangular pattern on its belly and short, stubby limbs. It is often seen holding a small, silver pendulum.
A tall, lanky, yellow humanoid with a very large, hooked nose, and long, pointed ears. It has a ruff of white fur around its neck and is typically seen swinging a circular pendulum.
A small, orange crab with large, powerful pincers. It has four small legs and two large eyes on stalks that protrude from the top of its round body.
A large, powerful crab with one enormous, disproportionately large pincer and one smaller one. Its body is red on top and cream-colored on the bottom. It has a spiky crown on its head.
A spherical object that perfectly resembles a Poké Ball. It is red on top and white on the bottom, with a black band and a central button. It has two small, white eyes.
A spherical object that perfectly resembles a Poké Ball. It is red on top and white on the bottom, with a black band and a central button. It has two small, white, often angry-looking eyes.
A cluster of six pink, egg-like creatures. Each has a unique facial expression, and some show cracks on their shells. They are typically gathered in a small group on the ground.

A very tall, walking palm tree. It has a thick, brown trunk for a body and two stout legs. Three round, yellow, coconut-like heads, each with a distinct facial expression, sit atop its body, crowned by large, green palm leaves.
A small, bipedal, brown creature that wears a bone skull on its head, hiding its true face. It has a lonely appearance and carries a bone, which it uses as a club.

A fierce, bipedal, brown creature. The bone skull it once wore has now become an integral part of its own head. It has a more powerful build, a spiky tail, and wields a large bone as a formidable weapon.
A brown, humanoid creature with an egg-shaped body and no discernible head. Its arms and legs are cream-colored and coiled like springs, allowing them to stretch to great lengths for kicking.

A brown, humanoid creature with the appearance of a boxer. It has purple, pauldron-like shoulders and wears a small, gray, kilt-like garment. Its hands are permanently shaped into red, padded boxing gloves.
A large, bipedal, pink creature with a very stout body and a thick tail. Its most prominent feature is an incredibly long, prehensile tongue. It has a cream-colored, curved marking on its chest.

A floating, spherical, purple creature with a body resembling a naval mine, covered in crater-like pores. It has a wide, mischievous grin and large eyes, with a yellow skull-and-crossbones mark below its face.
A creature composed of two conjoined, purple, spherical bodies covered in gaseous vents. The main head is larger, while a smaller head is attached to its side. Both have vacant, grinning expressions.
A quadrupedal, rhinoceros-like creature made of gray, rocky plates. It has a short, stout body, a small horn on its snout, and a drill-like tail.
A massive, bipedal, rhinoceros-like monster covered in thick, gray, rocky armor. It has a powerful, upright stance, a large, sharp horn on its nose that resembles a drill, and a thick, powerful tail.
A large, pink, ovoid creature with a very gentle appearance. It has stubby arms and legs, and holds a single, white egg in a pouch on its belly. It has small, tufted "hair" on the sides of its head.
A mysterious creature composed of a tangled mass of blue, vine-like tendrils. Only its large, white eyes are visible from within the vines. It walks on two large, red, boot-like feet.

A massive, bipedal, reptilian creature with a tough, brownish-gray hide. It has a protective, pouch-like belly where it carries a smaller, juvenile version of itself. It has powerful hind legs and a thick tail.
A small, blue, seahorse-like creature with a curled tail. It has a long snout, small wings on its back, and a spiny dorsal fin. Its belly is cream-colored.
A large, blue seahorse with a tough, spiky exoskeleton. It has a more rigid body than its pre-evolution, with sharp, pointed fins on its back and head. Its belly is covered in cream-colored scales.
A white-and-orange goldfish. It has flowing, graceful fins, large, blue eyes, and a prominent, sharp horn on its forehead. Its body is predominantly white with large orange patches.
A large, powerful, goldfish-like creature. Its body is orange and black with white fins. It has a powerful, flowing tail and a large, sharp, drill-like horn on its head. Its expression is fierce.
A creature with a geometric, five-pointed star shape. It has a brown, crystalline body with a golden frame. In its center is a red, glowing, gem-like core.
A creature composed of two, five-pointed, star-shaped bodies stacked on top of each other. The front star is purple, the back star is larger and spins. It has a large, faceted, red gem in its center.
A humanoid creature with a pink, spherical body and thin, white limbs. It has blue, mitten-like hands and pointed, blue, elf-like shoes. It has a strange, mime-like face with red cheek-spots.
A bipedal, insectoid creature with a green, segmented exoskeleton. It has a reptilian head, large, white wings, and two massive, sharp scythes for forearms.
A humanoid creature with a purple dress-like body and a pink face. It has long, blonde hair, large, saucer-like eyes, and large, pink lips. Its hands are white and mitten-like.
A bipedal, yellow creature covered in black, tiger-like stripes. It has a stocky build, two long antennae on its head, and a generally fuzzy, electrified appearance.
A bipedal, fiery creature with a body made of reddish-orange, molten rock. It has a duck-like beak, a flame-like crest on its forehead, and a stocky, powerful build.

A massive, stag beetle-like insectoid with a huge, black exoskeleton. Its most prominent feature is a giant, vise-like pair of horns on its head, lined with spikes. It has a menacing, powerful appearance.

A bovine creature with a light brown, furry body and three distinct, long tails. It has a gray, shaggy mane around its neck and a head with three white marks on its forehead and a pair of sharp horns.
A medium-sized, reddish-orange fish, known for its vacant expression and weak, floppy body. It has large, empty-looking eyes, yellow, barbel-like whiskers, and a yellow, crown-shaped dorsal fin.

A colossal, serpentine, sea dragon-like creature with a long, blue body and a cream-colored underbelly. It has a fierce, three-pronged crest on its head, a gaping mouth, and small, dark blue fins running down its back.
A large, gentle, plesiosaur-like sea creature with a blue, spotted hide and a cream-colored underbelly. It has large, intelligent eyes, a long neck, and a large, gray, spiky shell on its back.
A small, amorphous, pinkish-purple blob with a gelatinous body. It has two tiny, black, dot-like eyes and a simple, stringy mouth. It can transform its cellular structure to mimic other beings.
A small, quadrupedal, mammalian creature with fluffy, brown fur. It has a bushy, cream-colored collar of fur around its neck, long, rabbit-like ears, and large, brown eyes.
A sleek, quadrupedal, aquatic creature with blue skin. It has a dark blue ruff around its neck, a long, mermaid-like tail with a fin, and fin-like ears.
A quadrupedal, canine-like creature with a body covered in sharp, yellow, spiky fur. It has a spiky ruff of white fur around its neck and a sleek, angular build.
A quadrupedal, fox-like creature with flame-orange fur. It has a fluffy, yellow collar of fur around its neck, a large, bushy yellow tail, and a tuft of yellow fur on its head.
A digital creature made of pink and blue polygonal shapes. It has a spherical head that floats separately from its blocky, bird-like body. It has a distinctly artificial and geometric appearance.

A small, prehistoric, aquatic creature resurrected from a fossil. It has a blue, squid-like body with numerous tentacles and a pair of large, circular eyes. It is housed within a light-brown, spiral-shaped shell.

A large, prehistoric, aquatic creature with a nautilus-like, spiral shell. The shell is now spikier. A large, blue, squid-like body with tentacles and sharp, predatory eyes protrudes from the shell's opening.

A prehistoric creature resurrected from a fossil, resembling a trilobite. It has a hard, black, dome-shaped shell, two large, glowing red eyes that stare out from the darkness underneath, and small, sharp claws.
A bipedal, prehistoric creature with a sleek, black, segmented body. It has a crescent-shaped head and two huge, sharp, scythe-like claws for arms. Its posture is hunched and predatory.

A large, draconic, prehistoric creature resurrected from amber. It has a gray, reptilian body, large, purple, leathery wings, and a sharp, arrow-headed tail. Its jaw is wide and filled with sharp teeth.

A colossal, bipedal creature with a huge, spherical body. It has dark teal-blue skin, a cream-colored belly, and closed eyes, giving it a perpetually sleeping appearance. Its feet are large and have three claws.

A large, elegant avian creature with sky-blue plumage. It has a three-plumed, crystalline crest on its head, piercing red eyes, and a very long, flowing, ribbon-like tail. Its wings appear to be made of ice.
A large, avian creature with spiky, yellow and black plumage. Its wings and tail are jagged and sharp, resembling lightning bolts. It has a long, pointed beak and small, triangular black eyes.
A magnificent, phoenix-like bird with golden-yellow plumage. Its head is topped with a three-pronged crest of flames, and its wings and long, flowing tail are perpetually engulfed in fire.
A small, serpentine, aquatic creature with a sleek, blue body and a white underbelly. It has a white, three-pronged fin on each side of its head, a small horn, and a white snout.
A long, elegant, serpentine creature with a blue, scaled body and a white underside. It has small, wing-like fins on its head and a series of smooth, pearl-like orbs on its neck and tail.
A large, gentle, bipedal dragon with smooth, orange skin. It has a pair of small, green wings on its back, a long tail, and two long, thin antennae on its head with a small horn between them.

A tall, bipedal, humanoid creature with a feline-like appearance. It has smooth, grayish-purple skin, a long, thick purple tail, and a pronounced chest. A thick tube of flesh connects the back of its skull to its spine. It has piercing purple eyes.
A small, pink, feline-like creature with a long, thin tail that widens at the tip. It has a short snout, large blue eyes, and large hind feet. Its body is covered in a fine layer of short fur.
A small, quadrupedal, reptilian creature with pale green skin. It has a large, dark green leaf on its head, red eyes, and a necklace of green buds around its neck.

A sleek, quadrupedal creature with a pale yellow body. It retains the large leaf on its head and the necklace of buds, but a single, pink flower has begun to bloom from the center bud. Its neck is longer and more graceful.

A large, quadrupedal, dinosaur-like creature with a yellow body. Two large, pink, hibiscus-like flowers with a central stamen bloom on its neck, and it has two long, antenna-like stamens sprouting from its head.
A small, bipedal creature with a long, slender body. Its back is bluish-black, and its underbelly is cream-colored. Four red, fiery spots are on its back from which flames erupt.
A long-bodied, quadrupedal creature resembling a weasel. It is primarily cream-colored, with a mane of flames erupting from around its neck. Its back is a dark blue-green.

A large, bulky, quadrupedal badger-like creature with a dark blue-green back and a cream-colored underside. It has a massive, explosive collar of fire erupting from around its neck and a powerful, intimidating stance.
A small, bipedal, crocodilian creature with blue skin. It has a large jaw, red eyes, and a series of sharp, red spines on its back and tail. It has a yellow, V-shaped marking on its chest.
A larger, bulkier, bipedal crocodilian with blue skin. The red spines on its back are larger and more pronounced. It wears a yellow, loincloth-like pattern of scales on its lower body.
A massive, bipedal, crocodilian monster with a very powerful, bulky build. It has blue skin with large, sharp, red plates on its back, tail, and head. Its jaw is enormous and lined with sharp teeth.
A small, quadrupedal creature resembling a ferret. It has cream-colored fur with brown ring markings on its body and a brown-tipped, bushy tail. It has brown ears and dark eyes.
A very long and slender, bipedal creature resembling a ferret standing upright. It has a sleek, cream-colored body with brown markings, a long neck, and small limbs.
A small, avian creature resembling an owl. It has a round, brown body, a cream-colored face with large, red-rimmed eyes. A single, large feather on each eyebrow resembles the hands of a clock.

A large, imposing owl with wide, powerful wings. It has brown plumage, a light-colored underside, and piercing red eyes. The feathers above its eyes are long and "V" shaped, resembling sharp eyebrows.
A bipedal insectoid resembling a ladybug. It has a red, spotted shell on its back that covers its wings. It has five stars on its back. Its face is humanoid with large, blue eyes.
A larger, more humanoid, bipedal ladybug-like creature. Its red, spotted shell has split to form a four-winged cape. It has a more defined body structure and two pairs of arms.
A small, spider-like creature with a green body. Its abdomen resembles a smiley face, with black spots for eyes and a mouth-like marking. It has a small, white horn on its head.
A large, purple spider with a fearsome, face-like pattern on its abdomen. It has long, yellow-and-purple-striped legs, large red eyes, and a sharp horn on its head.
A large, bat-like creature with a purple, four-winged body, resembling a cross. It has a gaping mouth with sharp fangs and a more streamlined, aerodynamic shape than its pre-evolutions.

A small, blue, anglerfish-like creature. It has a round body, two fin-like feet, and a yellow, teardrop-shaped marking around each eye. A long, thin antenna with two yellow orbs protrudes from its head.
A large, blue, dolphin-like anglerfish with a smooth, sleek body. It has a large, yellow, eye-mask-like marking and a long antenna on its head ending in a bright, yellow orb.
A very small, pale yellow, rodent-like creature. It is a smaller, more rounded version of Pikachu, with small black-tipped ears and pink cheek pouches. Its tail is short and jagged.
A small, pink, star-shaped creature, smaller and chubbier than Clefairy. It has a very simple, cute appearance with tiny, brown ears and a single curled tuft of hair on its head.
A very small, pink, spherical creature. It is a smaller, more rounded version of Jigglypuff, with tiny, stubby arms and large, red eyes.

A small creature whose body is mostly encased in a white, spiked eggshell. Only its head, arms, and feet are visible. It has a round head with small, black eyes and a crown-like pattern of red and blue triangles on its shell.
A white, bipedal, fairy-like creature with a bird-like shape. It has small, stubby wings, a rounded body, and a head with three spikes. Red and blue triangular patterns are on its body.
A small, spherical, green bird-like creature with a single, large eye in the center of its body. It has two small, white wings and two long, thin legs, causing it to balance like a pogo stick.

A large, green, totem-pole-like creature. It has a large central eye, and its body is adorned with colorful, wing-like patterns and geometric shapes. It has two sets of wings, one for flying and one for support.
A small, quadrupedal sheep whose fleece is made of fluffy, cream-colored wool. Its skin is blue, and it has a yellow-and-black-striped tail with a red orb at the tip.
A pink, bipedal sheep that has lost most of its wool. It has smooth, pink skin, a short, white mane of wool around its neck, and a yellow-and-black-striped tail with a blue orb at the tip.
A tall, bipedal, kangaroo-like creature with smooth, yellow skin. It has a long, black-and-yellow-striped tail with a red orb at its tip. It has long, black ears and a white belly.

A small, green, bipedal creature with a hula-dancer-like appearance. It wears a skirt made of green leaves and has two yellow, maraca-like flowers in its hands. A single, red flower grows on its head.
A small, spherical, blue, rodent-like creature with a rubbery texture. It has large, round, white ears, a thin, black, zig-zag tail, and a large, white, puffy ball at the end of its tail.
A bipedal, egg-shaped, blue rodent. It has a large, white, circular pattern on its belly. It has long, rabbit-like ears and a thin, black, zig-zag tail with a blue orb at the tip.
A brown, tree-like creature that perpetually holds a stiff, straight pose to mimic a tree. It has long, thin arms with three green, spherical growths on the ends of its "hands" resembling foliage.
A large, green, bipedal frog with a very powerful and confident look. It has a large, curled crest of skin on its head, yellow markings on its body, and a light blue underbelly.
A small, round, green creature with large, red eyes and two long, leaf-like propellers sprouting from its head. Its body is very light and often carried by the wind.
A pink, cat-like creature with three propeller-like growths on its body: two dandelion-puff-like "ears" and one flower-like tail. It has simple, dot-like eyes.
A blue, spherical creature with two large, cotton-puff pom-poms for hands. A dandelion-like tuft grows on its head, and it has a small, fluffy tail. It has a cheerful expression with yellow eyes.
A purple, monkey-like creature with a long, prehensile tail that ends in a hand-like appendage. It has a large, smiling mouth and a tuft of hair on its head.
A small, seed-like creature with a yellow body and a single, small sprout on its head. It has small, black eyes and a simple, jagged mouth.
A bright yellow, bipedal plant creature resembling a sunflower. It has a round head surrounded by large, yellow petals, and its body is green with a leaf-like collar. It has a perpetual, wide smile.
A large, green, dragonfly-like insectoid. It has two massive, red, globe-like compound eyes that take up most of its head, and two pairs of powerful, transparent wings.

A small, amphibious creature with a light blue, gelatinous body. It has no arms, walks on two small feet, and has a large, smiling mouth and simple, black eyes. It has three purple, gill-like appendages on its head.
A large, bipedal, amphibious creature with a brown, slimy body and a blue underbelly. It has a dopey, vacant expression, round blue fins on its head and back, and a finned tail.
A sleek, quadrupedal, feline-like creature with fine, lavender-colored fur. It has very large, pointed ears, a forked tail, and a single, red gem embedded in its forehead.
A sleek, black, feline-like creature. It has a slender body, piercing red eyes, and a series of glowing yellow rings on its ears, tail, and forehead. These rings glow in the dark.
A small, dark-blue, avian creature resembling a crow with a witch's hat. Its head and "hat" are a single feature, with a yellow, crooked beak and a tuft of feathers that looks like a hat's brim.

A bipedal creature where a Shellder has latched onto its head like a crown. It's a pink, dopey creature with a large, conical, spiked shell on its head, with a red gem on the front. A frill of white fur hangs around its neck.
A ghostly creature resembling a floating, dark-teal head with long, flowing, hair-like appendages. It has large, red eyes and a necklace of red orbs that float around its neck.
A thin, black, symbolic creature resembling a letter of the alphabet or a punctuation mark. Each one has a single, large, central eye. They are flat and typically seen attached to walls in groups.
A tall, blue, gelatinous creature resembling a punching bag. It has a blob-like body, two squinting eyes, and no arms. It has a small, black tail with two distinct eyes on it.

A quadrupedal, giraffe-like creature. Its front half is yellow with brown spots, featuring a long neck and two ossicones. Its back half is dark brown and has a separate, small, sentient head with sharp teeth on its tail.
A creature that resembles a green, bagworm-covered pinecone. It has a bumpy, conical shell and two large, round, white eyes that peer out from the shell.

A large, spherical, steel-gray creature resembling a fortress. Its body is a hardened, bumpy shell with several cannon-like tubes protruding from it. Its red, inner body is barely visible from the central opening.
A small, chubby, serpentine creature with a yellow body and blue-green stripes on its back. It has a pair of small, white, feathery wings, closed eyes, and a drill-like tail.
A purple, bat-scorpion hybrid creature. It glides on wing-like membranes between its arms and legs. It has large, pincer-like claws, a long tail with a stinger, and a large, lolling tongue.
A colossal, serpentine creature made of interconnected, silver-gray, metallic segments. It has a massive, rugged jaw with large, bolt-like protrusions on its sides and piercing red eyes.
A small, bipedal, pink, bulldog-like creature. It has a perpetually grumpy expression, a prominent underbite with fangs, and a frilly, dress-like marking on its lower body.
A large, bipedal, purple bulldog with a very intimidating appearance. It has a massive lower jaw with two huge, protruding fangs and a powerful, muscular build.
A spherical, blue, pufferfish-like creature. Its body is covered in sharp, light-colored spikes. It has large, pink lips and wide, expressive eyes.

A bipedal, insectoid creature covered in a sleek, metallic red exoskeleton. It has two massive pincers that have yellow-and-black, eye-like markings on them. It has two thin, transparent wings on its back.
A small, yellow, worm-like creature residing within a very hard, red, porous shell. Its head and limbs can protrude from the various holes in its turtle-like shell.
A large, bipedal, blue rhinoceros beetle. It has a powerful, humanoid build, sharp claws, and a single, massive, forked horn on its forehead used for lifting and throwing.

A sleek, bipedal, weasel-like creature with dark, bluish-black fur. It has a red feather for its left ear and a fan of three red feathers for a tail. It has long, sharp, white claws and a yellow gem on its forehead.
A small, bipedal bear cub with brown fur. It has a distinctive, cream-colored, crescent-moon-shaped marking on its forehead and round ears.
A large, bipedal bear with shaggy brown fur and a powerful, bulky build. It has a large, yellow, circular ring pattern on its belly and broad, powerful shoulders.
A creature composed entirely of living magma. It has a slug-like body of bright orange, molten lava that constantly drips. It has large, round, yellow eyes that emerge from the magma.
A large snail made of magma. Its body is a slug-like mass of molten rock, and its shell is a large, gray, hardened-lava boulder with holes from which flames erupt.
A small, quadrupedal creature resembling a piglet, covered in thick, shaggy, brown-and-tan striped fur that obscures its legs. It has a large, pink, pig-like snout and closed, slit-like eyes.
A large, quadrupedal wild boar covered in thick, shaggy brown fur. It has two large, curved, ivory-colored tusks, and its eyes are completely hidden beneath its fur.
A small, aquatic creature resembling a chunk of pink coral. It has a rounded body with four stubby legs and a branching, white coral growth on its back. It has a simple, cheerful face.
A small, light-blue, fish-like creature resembling a remora. It has a sleek, torpedo-shaped body, a single horn-like fin on its head, and large, dark eyes.
A red, octopus-like creature with a round head and eight tentacles. It has a yellow, suction-cup-like snout, yellow rings around its large eyes, and a hard, bumpy head.
A bipedal, penguin-like bird with red plumage. It has a white, hollow tail that it carries like a sack. Its face is framed by a white, beard-like pattern of feathers.

A very large, manta ray-like creature. It has a blue top side, a light-colored underside, and two long, wing-like fins. It has two long, antenna-like protrusions on its head and is often seen with a Remoraid attached to a fin.
A bipedal, avian creature covered head-to-tail in metallic, silver-colored armor. Its wings are like sharp, steel blades, and its tail is a collection of jagged, blade-like feathers.
A quadrupedal, canine creature with black fur. It has a reddish-orange underbelly and snout. It has bony, white, rib-like protrusions on its back and a small, skull-like marking on its forehead.
A large, slender, Doberman-like canine with black fur and a reddish-orange snout and underbelly. It has two large, curved, gray horns on its head and a long, devil-like, arrow-tipped tail.
A large, majestic, blue sea dragon. It has a powerful build, a long, tube-like snout, and intricate, coral-like crests on its head. It has small, fin-like wings on its back.
A small, light-blue, elephant calf-like creature. It has large, floppy ears with red pads on them, a short but functional trunk, and a short, stubby tail.
A large, quadrupedal, gray elephant armored with a thick, tire-like, black hide around its back and head. It has long, sharp, white tusks and can curl into a powerful rolling wheel.

A digital creature with a smooth, rounded, bird-like body. It is primarily red and blue, with a duck-like head and beak. It looks sleeker and more streamlined than its predecessor, like a child's toy.
A quadrupedal, deer-like creature with light brown fur. Its most notable feature is its large, brown antlers, which have two large, black, eye-like orbs at their center.

A bipedal, beagle-like creature with white and brown fur. It has a long tail that ends in a brush-like tuft, which secretes a colored paint-like fluid. It wears a green, beret-like growth on its head.
A small, humanoid creature with a pinkish-purple body and a brown, shorts-like pattern on its lower half. Its head has three rounded, blunt prongs. It has a scrappy, energetic appearance.
A brown, humanoid creature that perpetually spins on a large, metallic spike on its head like a spinning top. Its legs are long and powerful, used for kicking while it rotates.
A small purple creature with a kiss-like mouth. Has large black eyes, blonde hair, and psychic abilities. Ice/Psychic-type with a cute expression.
A small, yellow, bipedal creature with a shape resembling an electrical plug. It has two long antennae on its head, black stripes on its body, and a black, lightning-bolt-shaped marking on its chest.
A small, pinkish-red, pot-bellied creature with a simple, round body. It has a yellow, flame-like crest on its forehead and a lump on its back. Its body appears to be made of warm, soft magma.
A bipedal, bovine creature with a predominantly pink body and black, patch-like spots. It has a thick tail, small horns, a yellow bell around its neck, and a prominent udder.

A very large, pink, ovoid creature with a gentle expression. It has small, curled, wing-like appendages on its sides, a pouch on its belly containing a single egg, and curled tufts of "hair" on its head.

A large, quadrupedal, yellow, feline legendary creature resembling a saber-toothed tiger. It has black stripes, a mask-like, white-and-blue plate covering its face, and a long, flowing, purple mane on its back that resembles a storm cloud.

A large, quadrupedal, brown, canine legendary creature with a powerful, mastiff-like build. It has a gray, crown-like crest on its head that resembles smoke stacks, gray plates on its back, and white, shaggy fur around its neck.

A sleek, quadrupedal, light-blue, canine legendary creature with a graceful appearance. It has a large, hexagonal, cyan crest on its forehead and two long, white, ribbon-like streamers flowing from its back. It has white, diamond-shaped spots on its body.
A small, bipedal, reptilian creature with teal-green skin. It has a large, fin-like horn on top of its head, a red, diamond-shaped patch on its belly, and small, stubby arms.

A creature encased in a hard, gray, chrysalis-like shell. The shell is bumpy and segmented, with triangular openings that reveal its glowing red eyes inside. It has several short spikes protruding from its body.

A massive, bipedal, dinosaur-like creature with a tough, dark-green, armored hide. It has a series of large spikes on its back and tail, a purple, diamond-patterned plate on its belly, and a powerful, jagged jaw.

A colossal, draconic, bird-like creature with smooth, white-and-silver skin. It has a long neck, a blue underbelly, and massive, hand-like wings. It has two blue, fin-like plates running down its back and a blue, mask-like structure around its eyes.

A majestic, phoenix-like avian creature with brilliant golden and crimson plumage. It has a prominent, green-feathered crest on its head, a green band on its neck, and massive wings with green-tipped feathers.

A small, green, pixie-like creature with a round head and large, blue-tipped antennae. It has large, light-blue eyes ringed with black, and a pair of small, transparent wings on its back. It has pointed, elf-like feet.
A small, green, gecko-like reptile. It is bipedal, with a large, thick, green tail. It has yellow eyes with long pupils and a darker green stripe on its stomach.
A bipedal, gecko-like creature with a lean, green body. It has a large, crest-like leaf on its head, and three large, sharp leaves for a tail. It has yellow, orb-like nodules on its arms.

A tall, slender, bipedal gecko with a sleek, green body. It has two sharp, leaf-like blades growing from its wrists, a large, fern-like tail, and a crest of leaves on its head. Yellow, seed-like orbs grow on its back.
A small, bipedal, chick-like creature with fluffy, orange feathers. It has two tiny wings, a small, yellow crest of feathers on its head, and a powerful beak.

A bipedal, adolescent, chicken-like creature with orange and yellow feathers. Its arms are now more wing-like with three sharp claws. It has a prominent, three-plumed crest on its head and powerful, clawed legs.

A tall, humanoid, rooster-like creature with a powerful, athletic build. Its lower body is red, while its upper body is cream-colored. It has long, shaggy white hair, sharp talons, and can emit flames from its wrists and ankles.

A small, quadrupedal, amphibious creature, primarily light blue, resembling an axolotl. It has a large, dark blue fin on its head, two large, orange, spiky gills on its cheeks, and a large, flat, dark blue tail fin.

A bipedal, amphibious creature with a stocky, muscular build. It has a dark blue body with a light blue underbelly. It has a large, dark blue head-fin, two fin-like crests on its back, and prominent, orange, three-pronged gills.

A massive, bulky, bipedal amphibious monster. It has a dark blue body with a white underbelly, and a powerful, muscular frame. It has large, gray fins on its back and tail, and two large, fan-like, orange gills on its cheeks.
A small, quadrupedal, hyena-like creature with shaggy, gray fur and a black mane. It has a perpetually snarling expression with visible fangs, and red, piercing eyes.
A large, quadrupedal, hyena-like creature with a sleek body covered in long, black and gray fur. It has a large, black mane, piercing red eyes, and a powerful, intimidating posture.

A small, quadrupedal creature resembling a raccoon, with brown and cream-colored fur. It has a black, mask-like pattern around its eyes and moves in a distinct, zigzagging pattern. Its fur is bristly.
A long, slender, quadrupedal creature resembling a ferret or badger. It has a sleek, white-and-brown-striped body, sharp claws, and is built for incredible speed in a straight line.
A small, pinkish-purple caterpillar with a spiky body. It has large, yellow, ringed eyes, a small horn on its head, and a larger, pointed stinger on its tail.
A cocoon-like creature covered in white, silky threads. It is a round, white pupa with several sharp spikes protruding from its body. Two large, red eyes peer out from an opening in the silk.

A beautiful, butterfly-like creature with large, colorful wings. Its wings are primarily yellow and black, with red and blue spots. It has a slender, black body, large, green compound eyes, and long, black antennae.
A dense, purple, cocoon-like creature wrapped tightly in silk. It has a tough, hardened casing with several blunt spikes. Four small, red eye-holes are visible on its front.
A moth-like creature with a venomous appearance. It has angular, purple-and-green wings covered in a toxic dust. It has large, red compound eyes and a pair of long, feathery, green antennae.
A small, blue, quadrupedal creature that resembles a lily pad with legs. It has a large, green lily pad on its head that looks like a wide-brimmed hat. It has a yellow, duck-like bill.
A bipedal, platypus-like creature with a blue body and a green, sombrero-like lily pad on its head. It has a lighthearted appearance and is often seen with its hands held up.

A large, bipedal creature resembling a pineapple-duck hybrid. It has a green, poncho-like body, a stout yellow lower body, and a wide, sombrero-like lily pad on its head. It has a cheerful and festive look.
A small, bipedal creature resembling an acorn. It has a brown, acorn-cap-like head with a single spike, and a yellow body. It has small, black eyes and two stubby feet.
A bipedal creature with a dark, pointed, goblin-like body and a long, pointed nose. Its hands are large and white with three fingers. It has a green, leafy cape on its back.

A tall, lanky, scarecrow-like creature with a tan, wooden-looking body. It has a long, pointed nose, shaggy white hair, and two large, fan-like leaves for arms. Its feet resemble traditional Japanese geta sandals.
A small, avian creature resembling a swallow. It has dark blue plumage on its back, a white underbelly, and a red patch on its face. It has a forked tail with two long, red-tipped feathers.
A large, sleek, swallow-like bird with dark blue and white plumage. It has a confident and determined expression, a sharp crest on its head, and a long, forked tail with red markings.
A white, gull-like seabird. It has a long, yellow beak with a black tip, and long, blue-tipped wings. It has thin, orange legs and feet.
A large, pelican-like seabird. Its most prominent feature is an enormous, deep, yellow lower beak which it uses to scoop up water and prey. It has a white body and blue-and-black wings.
A small, humanoid creature with a white body and a green, bowl-cut-like hairstyle. It has large, red eyes and a red, horn-like protrusion on its chest that sticks out. Its legs are thin and spindly.
A slender, graceful, humanoid creature in a white, ballerina-like dress. It has a green, bob-cut hairstyle with two red, fin-like horns protruding from the front and back. It moves with elegance.
A tall, elegant, humanoid creature with a flowing, white gown-like body. It has green "hair" and a red, blade-like crest that runs through its chest. It has a graceful and serene presence.
A small, aquatic insect resembling a pond skater. It has a blue, spherical head with red eyes, and a small, yellow body. Four long, thin legs allow it to skate across the surface of water.

A large, intimidating, bug-like creature with four large, wing-like appendages that have eye-like patterns on them. It has a sharp, pointed head with red, menacing eyes and a sleek, black-and-green body.
A small, bipedal, mushroom-like creature with a green, spotted, toadstool cap for a head. It has a beige body, small, black eyes, and stubby arms.

A bipedal, kangaroo-like creature with a mushroom cap for a head. It has a powerful, athletic build, with a green, spotted cap, a beige body, and green, orb-like claws. Its tail is thick and powerful.
A large, sloth-like creature with shaggy, white fur and a lazy, dopey expression. It has long arms with sharp claws and brown rings around its eyes. It is almost always seen lounging.
A bipedal, ape-like creature with shaggy white fur and a hyperactive, energetic look. It has a large, red, ruff of fur around its neck, and its pupils are small and frenetic.
A massive, bipedal creature resembling a giant sloth. It has shaggy, white-and-brown fur, a huge, powerful build, and a perpetually lazy and relaxed expression on its face. It lies on its side.
A cicada-larva-like insectoid. It is a small, white, grub-like creature with six small legs and large, red eyes. It lives underground.
A large, cicada-like insectoid with a sleek, black body and large, transparent wings. It has a prominent, halo-like ring above its head and large, green, compound eyes.
The ghostly, hollowed-out shell of a cicada. It is a brown, fragile-looking husk with a vacant expression and a halo floating above its head. A large, open hole is visible on its back.

A small, pink, bipedal creature with a round body. It has a large mouth that is perpetually open as if shouting. It has circular, yellow-ringed ears and two small, yellow, plus-and-minus-shaped markings for eyes.
A bipedal, purple creature with a stocky build. It has two large, tube-like ears that it uses to amplify sound. Its mouth is large and has two visible fangs.
A massive, bulky, bipedal creature with a huge, gaping mouth. Its body is covered with various sound-emitting organs, including four large chimney-like tubes on its back and a pipe-organ-like tail.
A small, bipedal, humanoid creature with a stout, round body. It has a tan-colored body with a black, skirt-like marking. Its hands are large and three-fingered, and it has a top-knot-like hairstyle.

A massive, bipedal, sumo-wrestler-like creature. It has a huge, powerful build with a large belly and thick, pillar-like legs. It wears a black, mawashi-like garment. Its hands are open and ready for combat.
A small, blue, spherical creature that stands on a springy, zig-zag tail with a large, blue orb at the end. It is a baby version of Marill, with a cheerful but often crying expression.
A blue, stone-like creature with a triangular body and stubby feet. Its most prominent feature is a huge, red, magnetic nose that always points north. It has small, beady eyes.
A small, feline creature with sleek, purple fur and a mischievous, grinning expression. It has a large, crescent-shaped, yellow crest on its head and a tuft of fur on its chest.
An elegant, quadrupedal, feline creature with sleek, purple-and-cream fur. It has a fluffy, purple ruff around its neck and a long tail that resembles a pincushion.
A small, bipedal, gremlin-like creature with dark purple skin. It has a hunched posture, sharp claws, and most notably, large, multifaceted, crystalline gems for eyes.

A small, bipedal, yellow creature with a demure appearance from the front. On the back of its head is a massive, black, carnivorous jaw with sharp teeth and a single long strand of hair, acting like a ponytail.
A small, quadrupedal, creature covered in a heavy, metallic, gray shell-like armor. It has bright blue eyes that peer out from under its helmet-like head.
A larger, bulkier, bipedal version of its pre-evolution. It is covered in segmented, steel-gray armor plates with sharp edges. Its head is encased in a metallic helmet.

A massive, bipedal, dinosaur-like creature covered from head to toe in thick, silver-colored, metallic armor plating. It has a powerful build, numerous sharp horns and spikes on its head and back, and piercing blue eyes.
A small, blue, humanoid creature that sits in a meditative pose. Its head is large and white with two bulbous growths on top, resembling a turban. It has stout legs and a calm expression.
A tall, slender, humanoid creature with a graceful, yoga-like posture. Its lower body consists of large, pink, baggy pants-like growths. Its head has two large, pink, teardrop-shaped appendages.
A small, quadrupedal, canine-like creature with green fur. It has a very angular build, a yellow mane on its back, and a short, yellow-tipped tail.
A large, sleek, blue, canine creature built for speed. Its most prominent feature is a massive, jagged, lightning-bolt-shaped mane of yellow fur that covers its head and back.
A bipedal, cream-colored, rodent-like creature with long, rabbit-like ears. It has red markings, red cheek pouches shaped like a plus sign, and a tail tipped with a red plus sign.
A bipedal, cream-colored, rodent-like creature with short, floppy ears. It has blue markings, blue cheek pouches shaped like a minus sign, and a tail tipped with a blue minus sign.
A bipedal, firefly-like insectoid with a dark body. It has a purple face, a red-and-yellow collar, and a single, large, glowing, spherical tail used for light displays.
A bipedal, firefly-like insectoid with a dark body. It has a purple face, a yellow, coat-like marking around its neck and waist, and a soft, glowing light around its small tail.
A small, bipedal, plant-like creature. It has a green body, a leafy collar, and two large, beautiful roses, one red and one blue, in place of hands. It has three sharp thorns on its head.
A small, amorphous, green creature shaped like a pouch. Its body is mostly a stomach, with a large, puckered mouth with yellow lips. A single, curved, yellow feather-like antenna is on its head.
A massive, amorphous, purple blob. It has a huge, gaping mouth with long, yellow, mustache-like whiskers. Its body is soft and gelatinous with dark, diamond-shaped markings.
A small, vicious, piranha-like fish. Its upper half is blue, and its lower half is red with a rough, sandpaper-like texture. It has a massive jaw filled with sharp teeth.

A creature that resembles the front half of a shark, with no tail. Its body is sleek and torpedo-shaped, with a blue top and white underside. It has a yellow star marking on its snout and rough, abrasive skin.
A large, spherical, whale-like creature with bright blue skin. It has a perpetually smiling mouth, small fins, and two blowholes on its back. It resembles a giant, buoyant ball.
A colossal, zeppelin-like whale, the largest of all Pokémon. It has a long, blue body with a grooved, white underbelly. It has four small, white fins and a massive, horizontal tail.
A small, quadrupedal camel with a droopy, yellow body and a vacant expression. It has a single, green, volcano-like hump on its back that contains magma.
A large, quadrupedal camel with a red, shaggy coat and three blue rings on each flank. It has two prominent, volcano-like humps on its back that regularly smoke and can erupt.
A large, quadrupedal tortoise with wrinkled, brown skin. Its shell is black and hollow, resembling a furnace, with several openings that constantly billow smoke and embers.
A small, gray, pig-like creature that constantly bounces on its coiled, spring-like tail. It has a pink, pearl-like orb balanced on its head.
A large, bipedal, pig-like creature with a purple and black body. It has a large, jiggly belly, a powerful psychic stance, and three black pearls: one on its forehead and one on each hand.
A bipedal, panda-like creature with a dizzy, stumbling gait. It has cream-colored fur with unique, swirling, red spot patterns all over its body, and its eyes are depicted as swirls.
A small, insectoid creature with a massive, orange, spherical head and a tiny body. Its primary feature is its powerful, disproportionately large jaws capable of crushing rock.
A thin, green, dragonfly-like insectoid. It has two large, translucent, diamond-shaped wings, and its large eyes are covered by red, goggle-like membranes.
A large, bipedal, draconic insectoid with a sleek, green body. It has large, diamond-shaped wings that create a sandstorm when flapped, and its eyes are protected by large, red, goggle-like covers.
A small, bipedal, cactus-like creature. It has a round, green, spiky body, dark green, club-like arms, and a yellow, flowering growth on its head.
A tall, bipedal, scarecrow-like cactus creature with a dark green, spiky body. It has a ragged, triangular, hat-like crest on its head and glowing, diamond-shaped, yellow eyes.
A small, blue, bird-like creature. Its body is mostly enveloped by two massive, fluffy, cloud-like wings that feel like soft cotton. Its small, blue head peeks out from the top.

A large, serpentine, blue bird whose body is almost completely covered in a massive, elegant, cloud-like plumage. It has a long, graceful neck, a crest of feathers on its head, and a flowing, cloudy tail.
A quadrupedal, mongoose-like creature with a fierce rivalry stance. It is covered in thick, white fur with prominent, jagged, red, scar-like markings on its body. It has long, sharp, black claws.
A large, serpentine, black creature. Its body is adorned with yellow, hexagonal markings and large, purple, scar-like patterns. It has a pair of long, red fangs and a sharp, blade-like tail.
A levitating, crescent-moon-shaped creature made of craggy, beige-colored rock. It has a single, large, unblinking red eye in the center of its body.
A levitating, sun-shaped creature made of craggy, orange-colored rock. Its body is spherical with rocky spikes radiating outwards. It has a stern expression with two squinting eyes.
A small, catfish-like creature with a smooth, grayish-blue, slimy body. It has a black, zigzagging line down its side and two long, blue whiskers.
A large, blue catfish with a huge, gaping mouth and a perpetually dopey, smiling expression. It has long, yellow whiskers and a yellow "W" shaped marking on its forehead.
A small, red-and-white, crustacean-like creature. It has a scrappy look, large, powerful pincers, and a yellow, star-shaped crest on its head.
A large, bipedal, lobster-like creature with a dark red and cream-colored shell. It has massive, destructive claws, a menacing posture, and a prominent, yellow, star-shaped mark on its forehead.
A small, clay-doll-like creature that spins and balances on a single point. Its body is brown and top-shaped, with circular, red-and-white patterns. Its eyes are perpetually closed.
A large, bizarre, clay-doll-like creature with a black, rotund body. Its head is a separate, floating piece that rotates around its body, and it has multiple, glowing red eyes arranged in a ring.

A prehistoric, plant-like creature from a fossil. It has a purple, stalk-like body rooted to a spot, with a cup-shaped head from which eight pink, petal-like tentacles emerge. Two yellow eyes glow from within the head.
A large, bizarre, plant-monster with a long neck and a saucer-like body that allows it to move. Its head has eight large, pink tentacles, and it has a heavy, suction-cup-like base.
A prehistoric, arthropod-like creature from a fossil. It resembles an ancient shrimp, with a gray, segmented body, two large, white, feathery fins on its sides, and two large, stalked eyes.
A large, bipedal, prehistoric arthropod with a tough, black-and-blue armored exoskeleton. It has two massive, sharp claws, and two large, feathered wings on its back.
A fish with a shabby, ugly appearance. Its body is a dull brown with dark spots, looking battered and scarred. It has ragged, blue fins and large, vacant eyes.

A long, serpentine, sea-dwelling creature of breathtaking beauty. It has a cream-colored body, a long, flowing, pink, fin-like crest on its head, and a spectacular, fan-like tail with blue, pink, and black patterns.

A small, cloud-like creature with a simple, gray, spherical head and a teardrop-shaped body. It has the ability to change its physical form and type based on the weather, becoming fiery, watery, or icy.
A green, bipedal, chameleon-like reptile with a curled tail. It has a distinctive, red, zigzagging stripe across its belly that remains visible even when the rest of its body turns invisible.
A small, ghost-like creature resembling a hand puppet. It is a hollow, gray cloth with a pointed horn on top. Its true form is a small, spherical head covered by the cloth.
A vengeful, animated doll with a gray, cloth body. It has a zipper for a mouth, which it keeps closed to contain its energy. It has a long, yellow, brush-like tail and mismatched, button-like eyes.

A floating ghost that resembles a stylized Grim Reaper. It has a black, hooded body with no visible limbs, and wears a white, skull-like mask with a single, red, glowing eye that moves between two eye sockets.
A bulky, mummy-like ghost, wrapped in gray, bandage-like strips of cloth. It is a cyclops, with a single, large, red eye in the center of its face. Its hands float separately from its body.

A massive, sauropod-like creature with a long neck and a brown, dinosaur-like body. Its most striking feature is the set of huge, green, banana-tree-like leaves on its back that function as wings, and a cluster of yellow bananas growing under its chin.
A small, floating, bell-like creature. It is mostly blue and hollow, with a yellow, suction-cup-like appendage on its head. It has a long, patterned tail with a red orb at the end.
A majestic, quadrupedal, mammalian creature with pure white fur and dark gray skin. It has a sharp, sickle-shaped horn on the right side of its head, a long, fluffy tail, and powerful, clawed feet.
A small, blue, bipedal creature that resembles a smaller, more cheerful version of Wobbuffet. It has two large, ear-like appendages on its head and a black tail with an eye on it.

A small, shivering creature that resembles a person wearing a conical, yellow, straw raincoat (a yukinko). Its true body underneath is black, and only its round, blue eyes and trembling mouth are visible.
A levitating, spherical head made of black rock, completely encased in jagged, formidable ice armor. It has piercing, blue, crystalline eyes and a wide mouth filled with sharp, icy teeth.
A perfectly spherical, seal-like creature with blue fur and white spots. It has small fore-flippers and balances on its round body, often seen clapping or rolling.
A larger, chubbier, seal-like creature with blue fur and a thick, white, mustache-like growth of fur around its snout. It has two small but visible white tusks.
A colossal, walrus-like creature with a thick, blue-gray hide. It has a massive collar of white, shaggy fur around its neck and two enormous, sharp, ivory tusks.
A bivalve mollusk with a hard, blue shell that has a clamp-like hinge. Its true body is the single, large, pink pearl inside, which serves as its head.
A long, serpentine, deep-sea fish with a light-blue body and white spots ringed with orange. It has a powerful jaw, and its tail is shaped like a small, white fish, which it uses as a lure.
A long, serpentine, deep-sea fish with a bright pink body. It is known for its elegance and has a very long, thin snout used to probe for food. It has two small, seashell-like growths on its chest.
An ancient, coelacanth-like fish brought back from extinction. Its body is a patchwork of craggy, brown, rock-like scales and tan skin, giving it a fossilized appearance.
A small, flat, disc-shaped fish that is perfectly heart-shaped. It has a pink body, large eyes, and a small, white mark on its cheek.
A small, blue, quadrupedal, reptilian creature with a very hard, gray, helmet-like skull. It has stubby arms and a powerful desire to throw itself from high places to train its head.
A creature almost completely encased in a hard, white, spherical, bone-like shell. It resembles a living cocoon, with its powerful blue legs and red eyes visible from openings in the armor.

A large, powerful, quadrupedal blue dragon. Its most defining feature is a pair of massive, red, crescent-shaped wings that have grown as a result of its intense desire to fly. It has a fierce, predatory look.
A levitating, robotic creature consisting of a blue, metallic, teardrop-shaped body, a single large red eye, and a sharp claw on its rear. It communicates using magnetism.
A robotic creature formed by the fusion of two Beldum. It has a blue, saucer-shaped body with two powerful arms, each ending in sharp claws. Its red eye is centered in its metallic body.

A massive, spider-like, robotic creature formed by the fusion of four Beldum. It has a huge, blue-gray body, four powerful legs, and a large, metallic cross on its face. Its red eyes give it an intimidating, intelligent look.
A large, humanoid golem constructed entirely of jagged, brown and gray rocks. It has a hulking, powerful build, and its face consists of a pattern of seven orange dots in an "H" shape.
A large, humanoid golem sculpted from solid, transparent, crystalline Antarctic ice. The ice is incredibly hard. Its face consists of a pattern of seven yellow dots in a ":" shape.
A large, humanoid golem made of a smooth, incredibly hard, silvery-black metallic substance. Its body is hollow. Its face consists of a pattern of seven red dots in a hexagonal pattern.

A sleek, draconic, jet-plane-like creature. It has a white and red body, swept-back wings, and arms that can tuck into its body for speed. It has a blue, triangular marking on its chest and gentle, yellow eyes.

A sleek, draconic, jet-plane-like creature, larger and more angular than its counterpart. It has a white and blue body, sharp, swept-back wings, and a red, triangular marking on its chest. It has sharp, red eyes.

A colossal, primordial, whale-like sea creature. Its body is deep blue and covered in intricate, red, tribal-like markings that glow when it is powered up. It has two massive pectoral fins and a bifurcated tail.

A colossal, primordial, bipedal dinosaur-like land creature. Its body is covered in thick, red, armor-like plates, with black, tribal-like markings that glow with magma when it is powered up. It has massive claws and a powerful tail.

A massive, green, serpentine sky dragon with a long, sinuous body. It has yellow, ring-like patterns running along its length, and several red-tipped, fin-like appendages. Its jaw is powerful and jagged.

A small, humanoid creature with a silver, star-shaped head and two yellow, paper-tag-like streamers. It has a white body, stubby arms and legs, and a third, "true eye" on its stomach that is usually closed.

An alien virus that mutated into a Pokémon. Its primary form is a sleek, bipedal creature with an orange and blue-green body, two tentacle-like arms, and a purple, crystalline organ in its chest. It can alter its form for attack, defense, or speed.
A small, quadrupedal, turtle-like creature with light green skin and a yellow jaw. A small, green seedling with two leaves sprouts from its head, which is covered by a patch of hard, brown soil.
A larger, bulkier, quadrupedal turtle. The seedling on its back has grown into a small, sturdy bush with two yellow, berry-like flowers. Its shell is a solid plate of brown earth.
A colossal, quadrupedal tortoise of immense size and weight. A living, miniature ecosystem, including a large, solitary tree, grows upon the shell on its back. Its face is craggy and mountain-like.
A small, bipedal, chimpanzee-like creature with orange fur and a cream-colored belly. Its tail is a constantly burning flame, and it has a distinctive red patch on its rump.

A bipedal, monkey-like creature with an energetic, martial-arts stance. It has white fur on its torso, orange limbs, and blue and red markings on its face. The flame on its tail is larger and more intense.
A tall, slender, humanoid ape with a fiery, acrobatic appearance. It has a crown of fire on its head, white fur, brown limbs, and golden, armor-like plates on its shoulders, chest, and knees.
A small, penguin chick with a proud personality. It has a light blue body, a dark blue head that extends down its back like a cape, and two white, button-like spots on its chest.
An adolescent penguin with a sleek, dark blue body. It has sharp, metallic-looking edges on its wings, and a prominent, golden, trident-like crest has begun to form on its face.

A large, majestic, emperor penguin-like creature with a powerful and regal stance. Its wings are edged with sharp, steel-like blades, and a massive, golden, three-pronged trident grows from its face, covering its beak.
A small, avian creature resembling a starling. It has gray and black plumage, a white face, and a single, distinctive plume on its head that dips forward over its face.
A larger, more aggressive-looking starling. It has a noticeable crest of feathers on its head that is swept forward, giving it a punk-rock-like appearance. Its gaze is sharp and focused.
A large, powerful bird of prey with a formidable appearance. It has a massive, red-tipped, black crest that sweeps up and back like a pompadour hairstyle. It has fierce red eyes and a powerful build.
A small, brown, beaver-like rodent with a perpetually dopey expression. It has large front incisors, a chubby, round body, and a small, puffy, club-shaped tail.
A large, bipedal, beaver-like rodent with a stocky and goofy build. It has brown and cream-colored fur, prominent front teeth for gnawing, and a large, flat, black tail used for slapping mud.
A small, bipedal, insectoid creature resembling a cricket. It is dark gray with a red collar-like marking and has two long, black antennae that it rubs together to make music.

A bipedal, violin-like insectoid. It has a majestic, conductor-like appearance with long, scythe-like arms, a red body, cream-colored wings that form a cape, and a sophisticated, mustache-like facial marking.

A small, quadrupedal, lion-cub-like creature with blue fur. It has a star-shaped tuft of fur at the tip of its black tail and a tuft of black fur on its head. Its front paws are disproportionately large.
A larger, quadrupedal, lion-like creature with blue and black fur. It has a sharp, spiky mane of black fur covering the front of its body, yellow eyes, and a powerful, lean build.
A large, majestic, quadrupedal lion with a massive, star-shaped, black mane. Its sleek, black-and-blue body is built for power and speed. Its eyes glow with a piercing, x-ray-like vision.
A small, bipedal, plant-like creature. It is a green bud with short, stubby legs and closed eyes. A single, closed rosebud sits on top of its head.
A graceful, bipedal, humanoid plant creature with a masquerade-ball theme. Its arms are bouquets of beautiful red and blue roses, and it wears a green, leaf-like cape and mask.

A small, bipedal, dinosaur-like creature resurrected from a fossil. It has a gray, reptilian body, and its most prominent feature is a very hard, blue, dome-shaped skull which it uses for headbutting.
A massive, bipedal, pachycephalosaurus-like dinosaur with a powerful, stocky build. It has a huge, blue, dome-shaped skull, with smaller spikes around the dome. Its body is dark gray and blue.

A small, quadrupedal, ceratopsian dinosaur resurrected from a fossil. Its face is protected by a wide, flat, shield-like plate of bone, with several spikes protruding from the edge. Its body is small and brown.
A massive, quadrupedal, ceratopsian dinosaur with an impenetrable defense. Its head is a colossal, square-shaped, fortress-like shield, with sharp horns and a thick, armored body.

A small, insect larva that creates a cloak for itself out of surrounding materials. It can have a green Plant Cloak, a sandy Ground Cloak, or a pink-and-white Trash Cloak, with only its black, conical head visible.
A bipedal, female, moth-like insectoid. Its appearance depends on its larval cloak: Plant Cloak form has leafy wings, Sandy Cloak has brown, tattered wings, and Trash Cloak has pink, patchwork wings.
A small, male, gnat-like insectoid with a gray body. It has two large, compound eyes, a pair of simple, transparent wings, and long, forked antennae.
A living honeycomb structure composed of multiple hexagonal cells. Each cell contains a small, larval, bee-like face with a single antenna. The lower central cell contains a larger, female larva.
A large, female, bee-like insectoid with a regal appearance. Her lower body is a massive, orange-and-black, honey-filled abdomen that acts as a flying hive. She has a small, red gem on her forehead.
A small, white, squirrel-like rodent with a long, fluffy tail that splits into two large prongs. It has a yellow stripe down its back and two yellow cheek pouches.

A sleek, quadrupedal, weasel-like creature with a brown body. It has a bright yellow, inflatable, inner-tube-like flotation sac around its neck. It has two long, fin-like tails that can spin like a propeller.
A larger, more powerful, bipedal weasel-like creature with a tan-and-brown body. The flotation sac around its neck is now a large, well-developed collar, and it has a powerful, muscular build.
A small, bipedal creature resembling a cherry. It has a round, deep-pink body with a second, smaller, underdeveloped head attached by a short, green stem.
A cheerful, plant-like creature. In its Overcast Form, it is a closed, purple flower bud. In its Sunshine Form, it blooms into a vibrant, pink, bipedal creature with two round, cherry-like heads.
A small, amorphous, sea-slug-like creature. It has a soft, slimy body. Its appearance varies by location: West Sea form is pink and white with two small, fin-like appendages on its back.
A larger, slug-like creature with a soft, gelatinous body. The West Sea form is pink and brown, with a frilly mantle and three small horns on its head.
A purple, monkey-like creature with two long tails, each ending in a large, hand-like appendage with an eye on it. It has a large tuft of purple hair that splits its face in two.
A spherical, balloon-like creature made of a thin, purple membrane. It has two long, string-like arms with yellow, heart-shaped tips. A small, white, cloud-like puff of fur sits on its head.

A large, hot-air-balloon-like creature with a purple, spherical body and a cross-shaped, yellow marking on its face. Its arms are long and wavy, and its "mouth" is a small, sealed opening at its base.
A small, bipedal, rabbit-like creature with brown fur. Its most notable feature is its long, fluffy, cream-colored ears, which are rolled up like pigtails. It has a small, puffy tail.
A tall, slender, bipedal rabbit with a sophisticated and fashionable appearance. It has long, brown legs, a white, fluffy vest, and long, flowing ears with fluffy tips.
A ghost-like creature with a witch-like appearance. It has a wide-brimmed, purple, hat-like head with flowing, purple, hair-like extensions. It has glowing, yellow eyes and a flowing, ragged body.
