A large, avian creature with a dark, mafioso-like appearance. It has a black body, a white, feathered chest, and a large, wide-brimmed, fedora-like crest of black feathers on its head.
A gray, feline creature with a haughty and spoiled demeanor. It has a distinctive, forked tail and a coiled, spring-like tuft of fur around its neck. Its ears are partially closed.
A large, sleek, purple feline with a disdainful expression. It has a massive, boa-like tail that is wrapped around its torso. Its body is plump and its whiskers are long.

A small, blue, bell-like creature with a hollow body. It has a single, clapper-like appendage inside and a long, ribbon-like tail. Its eyes are simple and round, and it has a suction-cup-like appendage on its head.
A small, quadrupedal, skunk-like creature with purple fur. It has a single, cream-colored stripe running from its head down its large, bushy tail, which it holds over its head.
A large, quadrupedal, skunk-like creature with a powerful, intimidating stance. Its large, striped tail is now split in two and can be used to spray a foul-smelling liquid over long distances.
A levitating, circular, bronze-colored object resembling an ancient mirror or bell. It has a simple, carved face and two red, eye-like knobs on its sides.
A massive, floating, ancient bell of a dark teal color with intricate, golden patterns. It has two large, arm-like appendages and a deep, resonant voice.
A small, brown, rock-like creature that resembles a bonsai tree. It has three green, spherical growths on its head, and it often has a stream of tears flowing from its eyes.
It has a red, mime-like nose and ball-shaped hands. It has two long, antenna-like growths on its head, each ending in a blue sphere.
A small, pink, egg-shaped "baby" creature. It has a single, curled pigtail on its head, and wears a smooth, round, white stone in its belly pouch, resembling an egg.
A small, brightly-colored, parrot-like bird. Its body is a mix of green, blue, yellow, and black feathers, and its head is shaped like a black, eighth musical note.
A creature formed from 108 spirits bound to a fissure in a stone. Its physical form is a swirling vortex of purple ectoplasm emerging from a small, gray, keystone-like rock with a single carved face.
A small, quadrupedal, land-shark-like dragon. It has a blue body, a red underbelly, and a large fin on its back. Its head is large with two horn-like appendages that resemble jet engines.
A bipedal, draconic creature with a powerful build. It has a dark blue body, a red belly, and sharp, scythe-like claws on its arms. Its fins have become more rigid and wing-like.
A large, bipedal, draconic creature with a sleek, aerodynamic body resembling a fighter jet. It has large, wing-like fins on its arms, a hammer-shaped head, and a powerful, shark-like tail fin.
A small, bipedal, chubby "baby" creature. It has dark blue fur, a cream-colored belly marking, and its eyes are almost always closed in a happy expression. It is known for its voracious appetite.
A small, bipedal, canine-like creature with blue and black fur. It stands on its toes and has three appendages on the back of its head that it uses to sense auras. It has red eyes.
A tall, bipedal, canine-like creature with a sleek, blue-and-black body. It has a spike protruding from its chest and one from the back of each hand. It has a noble and heroic appearance.
A small, quadrupedal, hippopotamus-like creature. It has a light brown body with a darker brown, camouflage-like pattern on its back. It expels sand from the nostrils on its back.
A massive, quadrupedal hippopotamus with a dark gray, almost black, body and a sandy-brown jaw. Its back is covered in several large pores that constantly pour out sand.
A small, purple, scorpion-like creature with a segmented body. It has two large, blue-and-red pincers and a tail that is split into two sharp stingers. Its claws are connected directly to its head.
A large, intimidating, purple scorpion with a powerful, upright stance. Its claws are massive, with red and black markings, and its tail ends in a formidable, three-parted stinger.
A small, bipedal, frog-like creature with a slim, blue body and dark gray stripes. It has a cocky expression and large, red-orange poison sacs on its cheeks and on the first finger of each hand.
A tall, slender, bipedal, poison-dart-frog-like creature. It has a lean, athletic build, a large, inflatable, red throat sac, and three long, sharp, retractable, poisonous claws on each hand.
A large, bipedal, venus-flytrap-like plant creature. Its head is a massive, green-and-red, jawed trap with sharp teeth. It has two large, leaf-like arms and a stocky, green body.

A small, fish-like creature with a dark blue body. Its most prominent feature is a large, wing-like, butterfly-shaped tail fin that is light blue with pink spots. It has a long, glowing antenna on its head.
A large, beautiful fish with enormous, butterfly-like fins. Its body is dark blue, while its fins are a shimmering light blue with pink, eye-like markings. It has two long, ribbon-like antennae.

A small, aquatic creature resembling a baby manta ray. It has a blue, disc-shaped body, a cheerful expression with two large eyes, and two long, antenna-like fins. A smily-face pattern is on its back.
A small, bipedal, yeti-like creature. It is covered in shaggy, white fur, with a brown face and brown, stubby feet. It resembles a snow-covered pine tree.

A massive, bipedal, yeti-like creature covered in long, shaggy white fur. It has a powerful build, large hands, and green, crystalline spikes on its back. Its face is obscured by fur, with only its glowing blue eyes visible.

A slender, bipedal, weasel-like creature with a cunning and malicious look. It has dark gray fur, a large, red, fan-like crest on its head, and another on its tail. It has extremely long, sharp, white claws.

The final evolution of Magnemite, it's a large, heavy, saucer-shaped, metallic creature. It has a single, glowing red eye, two arms ending in powerful magnets, and a third magnet on its head with a yellow antenna.
A massive, bipedal, pink creature with a round, portly body. Its tongue is incredibly long and can be rolled up. It has a Wi-Fi-like symbol on its yellow-bibbed belly.

A massive, bipedal, rhinoceros-like monster with a bulky, brownish-orange, armored body. It has a large, powerful drill horn on its snout and wears protective, plate-like armor. It can shoot rocks from holes in its hands.

A huge, bulky creature composed of a tangled mass of thick, blue vines. It has long, vine-like arms with distinct, red-and-blue-tipped fingers. Its large, round, yellow eyes are the only visible feature of its face.

A large, bulky, ape-like creature covered in shaggy, yellow fur with black stripes. It has a powerful build, and its back has two long, black, pronged tails that it uses to deliver powerful electric shocks.
A large, stocky, fiery creature with a clown-like appearance. Its body is red and yellow, and its head has a flame-like crest. It has a massive, cannon-like arm that it uses to launch fireballs.
A graceful, white, bipedal, jet-plane-like fairy. It has a stout body, large, triangular wings on its back, and a serene, gentle expression. It has three horn-like crests on its head.
A huge, prehistoric, dragonfly-like insectoid with a massive, green body. It has six thin legs, two pairs of powerful wings, and large, red, compound eyes. A pair of sharp pincers are on its jaw.
A quadrupedal, mammalian creature with a feline appearance. Its body looks like it is covered in green, sprouting leaves. Its ears and tail are shaped like large, tattered leaves.
A quadrupedal, mammalian creature with a sleek, crystalline appearance. Its body is light blue and appears to be covered in sharp, ice-like shards. Its long, pointed ears and tail are frozen solid.
A large, purple, bat-scorpion hybrid. It has a more menacing appearance with larger, sharper pincers and a more prominent stinger. It has large, yellow, vampire-like eyes.
A colossal, quadrupedal creature resembling a woolly mammoth. It has a thick, brown, shaggy coat, two huge, curved, icy tusks, and a small, blue, mask-like pattern on its face.
A digital creature with a glitchy, erratic appearance. Its body is a distorted, saucer-like shape, with a detached, floating head and disjointed limbs. It appears unstable and unpredictable.

A slender, graceful, humanoid creature with a gladiator-like appearance. It has a white body, a green, helmet-like head with a red, crescent-shaped crest, and large, blade-like extrusions on its elbows.
A large, stone-like head with a massive, red, magnetic nose. It has a bushy, gray, mustache made of iron filings, and three smaller, "mini-nose" satellite units that float around it.

A massive, ghostly creature with a bulky, gray, stone-like body. It has long, striped arms, and a single, red, cyclopean eye. A large, cracked, yellow band circles its body, which it can open and close.

A ghostly, feminine figure with a beautiful but chilling appearance. It is a hollow, kimono-wearing ghost with a large, gaping mouth. Its arms are part of its sleeves, and it has a large, purple sash (obi) around its waist.

A small, plasma-based, electrical creature with a lightning-bolt-shaped aura. It can possess various household appliances, giving them a ghostly face and unique abilities: a microwave, a washing machine, a refrigerator, a fan, and a lawnmower.
A small, pixie-like, legendary creature with a pink body and two long, flowing, pink tails. It has a mostly blue head with a red gem embedded in its forehead.
A small, pixie-like, legendary creature with a cyan body and two long, flowing, cyan tails. It has a mostly yellow head with a red gem embedded in its forehead.
A small, pixie-like, legendary creature with a yellow body and two long, flowing, yellow tails. It has a mostly pink head with a red gem embedded in its forehead.
A large, quadrupedal, draconic legendary creature covered in metallic, blue-and-silver armor. A large, diamond-shaped gem is embedded in its chest. It has a powerful, majestic crest on its head.
A large, bipedal, draconic legendary creature with a white-and-gray body. It has massive, purple-and-pink, wing-like structures on its shoulders, adorned with large, perfect pearls.

A legendary creature with a body of molten steel. It is a quadrupedal, tortoise-like being with a gray, metallic shell and orange, magma-filled cracks. It has powerful, clawed feet and can walk on walls and ceilings.

A colossal, humanoid golem with a powerful, almost god-like appearance. It is white with a large, golden, cross-like structure on its torso. It has gray shoulders, and its face is a screen of seven black dots. It is often depicted moving continents.

A massive, shadowy, serpentine dragon of immense power. In its Altered Forme, it has six powerful, ghostly legs and two large, black, tattered wings. In its Origin Forme, it is a floating, serpent-like being with multiple shadow tendrils.

A beautiful, swan-like, lunar legendary creature. It has a graceful, serpentine body, small, pink, wing-like appendages on its back, and a crescent-moon-shaped head crest. It has glowing, red rings on its body.
A small, blue, aquatic, legendary "baby" creature. It has a large, spherical head with a red gem inside, and two long, blue antennae. Its body is gelatinous and it has a small, stubby tail.
A graceful, pixie-like, aquatic legendary creature. It has a blue, gelatinous body, a large head with a red gem inside, and two very long antennae. It is considered the prince of the sea.

A sleek, shadowy, ghost-like legendary creature. It has a thin, black body, long, white, flowing hair, and long, spindly legs. It has a red, spiky collar around its neck and piercing, blue eyes. It appears to be floating.

A small, white, hedgehog-like mythical creature. In its Land Forme, it has green, grass-like fur on its back and a pink flower on each side of its head. In its Sky Forme, it becomes a sleek, canine-like creature with a confident look and a red, scarf-like petal.

A majestic, equine-like, legendary creature with a pure white body. It has a long, golden mane, golden hooves, and a large, golden, cross-like wheel attached to its abdomen. Its face is gray with green eyes.
A small, psychic, mythical creature with a green, tufted crest on its head that resembles a "V". It has large, blue eyes, pointed, elf-like ears, and two small wings on its back.
A small, serpentine, grass snake with a smug expression. It has a pale green body with a dark green back. A large, lily-like leaf is at the end of its tail.
A sleek, serpentine creature with a regal and aloof posture. It has a green body, a high, upturned collar of leaves, and small, curled appendages that look like hands.

A majestic, colossal, serpentine creature with a long, green-and-white body. It has an elegant, regal head with a large, ornate crest. Its body is coiled gracefully, and it has two large, leaf-like appendages on its back.
A small, quadrupedal, fire pig with a round, orange body and black markings. It has a spherical, red nose and a black, coiled tail with a red orb at the tip.
A bipedal, pig-like creature with a stocky, wrestler-like build. It has a powerful, orange-and-black body with golden, ornate patterns on its chest.
A massive, bipedal, boar-like creature with a thick, powerful build. It is adorned with intricate, flame-like patterns on its body, and a massive, thick beard made of black, solidified fire.
A small, quadrupedal, sea otter-like creature with a light blue body. It has a white, round head with small, dark ears, and a prominent, shell-like, beige "scalchop" on its belly.
A bipedal, sea otter with a more mature, samurai-in-training appearance. It has a blue body, a helmet-like growth on its head, and carries its beige "scalchop" on its hip like a sword.

A large, quadrupedal, sea lion-like creature with a noble, samurai-like presence. It has a blue-and-white body, a large, horned, helmet-like shell on its head, and wields two large, sharp "seamitars" made from the shells on its forelegs.
A small, quadrupedal, rodent-like creature with brown fur, resembling a chipmunk. It has large, red eyes, a cream-colored underbelly, and a puffy, cream-tipped tail.

A large, bipedal, meerkat-like creature with a stern, sentinel-like posture. It has a long, slender body with brown fur, and its fur has yellow and red, stripe-like markings. Its eyes glow red when it is alert.
A small, quadrupedal, puppy-like creature with tan-and-brown fur. It has large, floppy ears, a blue-gray scruff of fur covering its face, and a short, stubby tail.
A quadrupedal, terrier-like dog with a refined, well-groomed appearance. It is covered in a large, heavy coat of long, shaggy, dark gray fur, with only its small head and paws visible.
A large, majestic, quadrupedal dog resembling a stoutland. It has a very long, thick, mustache-like and eyebrow-like coat of dark gray fur, giving it a wise and noble appearance.
A small, slender, feline creature with purple fur. It has a devious, cunning expression, large green eyes with slit pupils, and two sharp, sickle-like tufts of fur on its tail.
A sleek, bipedal, feline creature with a slender, purple-and-tan body. It has a cruel and arrogant expression, sharp claws, and two long, blade-like tails.
A small, monkey-like creature with a green body, resembling broccoli. It has a large, leafy, broccoli-floret-like tuft of fur on its head and a leaf-tipped tail.
A larger, bipedal, monkey-like creature with a punk-rock aesthetic. It has a large, Elvis-like pompadour made of green, leafy fur, a cream-colored body, and a prickly, mace-like tail.
A small, monkey-like creature with a red body. It has a flame-shaped tuft of fur on its head and a simple, red-tipped tail.
A larger, bipedal, fire-monkey creature with a rebellious look. It has a large, fiery crest on its head, a powerful build, and embers smoldering on its shoulders and tail.
A small, monkey-like creature with a blue body. It has a fountain-like sprout of fur on its head from which it can spray water.
A larger, bipedal, water-monkey creature with a relaxed, dreadlocked appearance. Its head is covered in long, blue, water-filled dreadlocks that it can use as powerful water cannons.
A small, round, pink, tapir-like creature with a floral pattern on its body. It has a short, trunk-like snout and closed eyes, giving it a perpetually sleepy look.
A larger, floating, tapir-like creature. It has a plump, purple-and-pink body, a long, trunk-like snout, and a cloud of pink, dream-mist flowing from a port on its forehead.
A small, avian creature resembling a common pigeon. It has gray plumage, a dark crest on its head, and a black-and-pink pattern around its eyes.
A proud, pigeon-like bird with a more developed, swept-back crest. It has a heart-shaped, pink marking on its chest and a confident, determined expression.
A large, pheasant-like bird. The male is majestic with a large, colorful wattle and long tail feathers. The female is more subdued with brown plumage. Both have a confident, almost arrogant look.
A small, quadrupedal, zebra-like creature with a very angular, stylized body. It has black-and-white stripes and a white, spiky mane that stands on end when it discharges electricity.
A large, powerful, zebra with a sleek, black-and-white striped body. Its mane is a jagged, lightning-bolt-like crest of white, electrified hair. It is built for incredible speed.
A small, quadrupedal creature whose body is a chunk of dark, hexagonal rock. It has a single, large, yellow, hexagonal crystal for an ear/eye, and stands on two stout, rock-like legs.
A large, bipedal creature made of crystalline blue rock. It stands on two powerful, pillar-like legs and has a large, single, orange crystal protruding from the top of its body.
A colossal, bipedal golem made of jagged, blue rock. It has several large, sharp, orange-red energy crystals protruding from its body, especially its arms and head. It glows with immense power.

A small, fluffy, bat-like creature. Its body is a single, round puff of blue-gray fur with a single, large, pig-like nose in the center, which also functions as its mouth and ears. It has a heart-shaped nose print.
A more elegant, bat-like creature with a graceful, humanoid body. It has a large, fur ruff around its neck, large, wing-like ears, and a heart-shaped snout. Its tail is forked.
A small, mole-like creature with a blue-and-gray body. It has large, sharp, three-pronged, metallic claws on its hands and a single, drill-like claw on its head.
A large, bipedal, mole-like creature covered in sharp, metallic armor plates. Its head is a massive, powerful drill, and its hands have become large, formidable, steel-bladed drills.
A bipedal, pink-and-cream-colored creature with a gentle, nurse-like appearance. It has large, floppy ears with long, curled, feeler-like appendages.
A small, stout, grayish-pink, humanoid creature. It has a very muscular upper body, a bulbous red nose, and is always seen carrying a heavy, wooden log.
A larger, more muscular, humanoid creature with a powerful build. It has bulging veins, a clown-like red nose, and now carries a massive, steel I-beam as a weapon.
A massive, incredibly muscular, humanoid creature with a monstrous, powerful physique. It has a rugged, gray skin, a grotesque face with a red nose, and wields two huge, concrete pillars as weapons.
A small, tadpole-like creature with a spherical, blue body. It has a fin-like tail and two large, prominent, round bumps on the sides of its head, which it vibrates to create sound waves.
A bipedal, toad-like creature with a blue body. The bumps on its head have become larger and more defined, resembling headphones. It has a stocky build and a warty texture.
A massive, bipedal, toad-like monster with a bulky, powerful frame. Its body is covered in large, warty, blue-and-red lumps that function as powerful speakers and vibrators.
A short, stocky, humanoid creature resembling a judo practitioner. It has red, rock-like skin, a powerful build, and wears a white-and-black judogi. Its eyebrows are thick and black.
A slender, agile, humanoid creature resembling a karate practitioner. It has blue, rock-like skin and wears a tattered, white-and-black karategi. It has a focused, sharp expression.
A small, insect larva with a caterpillar-like body. It is wrapped in a cloak made of a single, large, green leaf, with only its head, which has two leaf-like antennae, visible.
A pupa-like creature completely encased in a tight wrapping of green leaves, resembling a sleeping bag. Only its two, large, yellow eyes are visible from a small opening.
A large, bipedal, praying-mantis-like insectoid with a leafy, plant-like body. It has two massive, sharp, leaf-like scythes for arms and a collar of leaves around its neck.
A small, centipede-like insectoid with a purplish-pink, segmented body. It has two large, yellow antennae and a pair of sharp mandibles. It stands on four small legs.
A creature encased in a hard, gray, tire-like shell. It is a curled-up, centipede-like being that can spin at high speeds for defense and attack. Red eyes glow from within the shell.
A massive, horse-sized, centipede-like insectoid with a formidable, armored, purple-and-red body. It has large, curved horns on its head and tail, and a powerful, intimidating presence.
A small, floating, cotton-ball-like creature. It has a brown, star-shaped "face" with orange eyes, and two small, green leaves on its back.
A mischievous, sheep-like creature whose body is a massive, fluffy ball of cotton. It has a brown, horned head peeking out from the cotton, and is known for its playful, pranking nature.
A small, plant-like creature with a green, bulb-shaped body. A single, large, green leaf grows from its head. It has a simple, doll-like face with large, brown eyes.
A beautiful, humanoid, plant-like creature with a regal appearance. It wears a dress made of green leaves, and its "hair" is a massive, ornate, red-and-yellow, crown-like flower.
A ferocious, piranha-like fish. The Red-Striped form has a black body with a red stripe and red, aggressive eyes. The Blue-Striped form has a blue stripe and a slightly different fin shape.
A small, quadrupedal, crocodilian creature with a tan body and black stripes. It has large, bulging eyes with black, goggle-like markings around them, and a powerful jaw.
A larger, more robust, quadrupedal crocodilian. It has a powerful build, a dark, reddish-brown body with black, diamond-shaped markings, and a menacing, punk-rock-like crest of scales on its snout.
A massive, bipedal, crocodilian monster with a dark, reddish-brown and black body. It has a very powerful, intimidating build, a long, sharp snout, and dark, sunglass-like membranes over its eyes.
A small, round, fiery creature with a daruma-doll-like appearance. It has an orange-red body, yellow, flame-like eyebrows, and a perpetually energetic and smiling expression.
A large, ape-like, daruma-like creature. Its Standard Mode is a fiery, red-and-orange beast with massive arms and a crown of fire. Its Zen Mode is a dormant, blue, stone-like statue.
A bipedal, cactus-like creature with a cheerful, maraca-playing appearance. It has a green, bumpy body, yellow, spiky growths on its arms and head resembling flowers, and a wide, toothy grin.
A small, hermit-crab-like creature with an orange body. It lives inside a heavy, perfectly cubical, layered chunk of rock that it carries on its back.
A large, bipedal, crustacean-like creature. Its body is long and yellow, and it carries a massive, heavy, rectangular block of stratified rock on its back, which it uses for defense.
A small, bipedal, lizard-like creature with baggy, yellow skin that it has to constantly pull up like pants. It has a rebellious, punk-like attitude and a small, red crest on its head.
A tall, bipedal, lizard-like creature with a punk or gang-member appearance. It has a prominent, red, mohawk-like crest of skin, and it wears its shed, baggy skin around its waist like pants.

A bizarre, avian-like creature with a brightly colored, geometric body that resembles a kachina doll or a Nazca Line drawing. It has a green, cactus-like body, two wing-like arms, and a small, round head with a third eye.
A ghostly creature that is a shadowy, black spirit possessing an ancient, golden, funerary mask. The mask has a simple, smiling face, and the spirit has a single, glowing red eye.
A ghostly creature composed of a large, golden, sarcophagus-like body. Four shadowy, bandage-like arms protrude from it, and a large, menacing, red-eyed face is on the front of the sarcophagus.
A prehistoric, turtle-like creature from a fossil. It has a small, blue body protected by a massive, hard, blue-and-black shell. It has powerful front flippers for swimming.
A massive, bipedal, sea turtle with a huge, powerful build. It has a dark, rugged shell on its back, incredibly strong front flippers that can crush rock, and a powerful jaw.
A prehistoric, bird-like creature from a fossil. It is a small, bipedal, reptilian bird with fluffy, blue-and-yellow plumage and small, underdeveloped wings.
A large, brightly colored, prehistoric, avian predator. It has powerful legs for running, large, feathered wings for gliding, and a sharp beak. Its appearance is a mix of reptile and bird features.
A small, sentient pile of trash contained within a torn, light-green, plastic garbage bag. Two large, round eyes peer out, and two small, trash-like appendages serve as arms.

A colossal, humanoid monster made of compressed garbage. Its body is a lumpy, greenish-brown mass, with one arm ending in a long, tube-like appendage and the other in three finger-like pieces of rebar.
A quadrupedal, fox-like creature with dark gray fur. It has a large, bushy, purple-and-gray tuft of fur on its head that covers its eyes, creating an illusion.
A slender, bipedal, fox-like creature with long, flowing, magenta-and-gray hair that covers most of its body. It has a vengeful, illusionist's appearance, with sharp claws and a sinister grin.
A small, chinchilla-like creature with white-and-gray fur. It has large, round ears, a fluffy tail, and is known for its obsession with cleanliness, using its tail to sweep.
An elegant, chinchilla-like creature wrapped in long, flowing, scarf-like boas made of white fur. It has a graceful and refined appearance, with a small, tufted tail.
A small, humanoid, "baby" creature with a purple head and a pink, bow-like growth on it. It has a pale, lavender-colored body and a very wide-eyed, psychic expression.
A bipedal, humanoid creature with a gothic-lolita fashion sense. It has a purple-and-white body, and its "hair" and "dress" are adorned with multiple, white, ribbon-like bows.

A tall, slender, humanoid creature with an elegant, almost cosmic, gothic appearance. It has long, black, flowing "hair" and a black, dress-like body adorned with white, ribbon-like appendages that resemble stars.
A small green and blue cell-like creature with a simple body, nucleus-like center, and a basic appearance
A bipedal creature composed of two small, distinct bodies with simple faces, encased within a larger sphere of green, gelatinous fluid. Small, stubby limbs protrude from the central mass.

A small, green, humanoid creature suspended within a much larger, transparent, gelatinous body. It has two large, floating, detached arms made of the same green gel, ending in three spherical fingers.

A small, duckling-like avian creature with light blue plumage. It has a small tuft of feathers on its head and a larger, downy tuft of feathers at its tail, giving it the appearance of wearing a life vest.
A large, graceful, swan-like avian creature with a white body. It has a long, curved neck, large, powerful wings, and a distinctive blue, corset-like marking on its chest.

A small, sentient creature resembling a single scoop of soft-serve ice cream. Its head is made of white, snow-like ice with small, blue, crystalline eyes and mouth, all resting on a small, brown, icicle-like cone.
A creature resembling a larger ice cream cone. Its head is a larger scoop of snow-like ice, and its body is a longer, icicle-like cone. It has two small, floating ice crystals that serve as hands.

A creature that resembles a double-scoop ice cream cone. It has two large, sentient heads made of snow-like ice, each with its own face. One head has a straw-like icicle protruding from it. The body is a frozen cone base.
A small, quadrupedal, fawn-like creature. Its fur color and the flower on its head change with the seasons: pink in Spring, green in Summer, orange in Autumn, and brown in Winter.

A large, majestic, quadrupedal stag. Its most prominent feature is its large antlers, which change dramatically with the seasons: sprouting pink flowers in Spring, covered in lush leaves in Summer, adorned with orange leaves in Autumn, and bare and white like ice in Winter.

A small, white, rodent-like creature resembling a flying squirrel. It has large, round, black ears, yellow, cape-like membranes between its arms and legs for gliding, and two yellow cheek pouches for storing electricity.
A small, bipedal, beetle-like creature with a round, dark body. Its head is covered by a blue and yellow, horned, knight's-helmet-like shell, giving it a scrappy, confrontational look.

A bipedal, insectoid knight fully encased in a spiraled, metallic, silver-and-gold shell that acts as armor. It wields two long, pointed, red-tipped lances for arms and has a red, plume-like crest on its helmet.

A small, mushroom-like creature whose cap is designed to perfectly mimic the top half of a Poké Ball, with a red top and white spots. Its lower body is a small, gray, stem-like base with pink, puckered lips.
A large, bipedal, mushroom-like creature. It has a large, flat, toadstool cap on its head and two smaller, shield-like mushroom caps on its arms. All three caps are patterned to look like Poké Balls.

An aquatic, jellyfish-like creature. The male is light blue with a ruffled collar and a single, crown-like tentacle. The female is pink with a puffy, frilled collar and two long, ribbon-like tentacles.

A large, majestic, jellyfish-like creature with a regal presence. The male is blue and resembles a king, with a huge, white, mustache-like growth. The female is pink and resembles a queen, with a heart-shaped mouth and a large, frilly head structure.
A flat, fish-like creature with a vertical, heart-shaped body. It is bright pink with large, gentle eyes and has two large, fin-like wings on its back and two smaller, hand-like fins on its front.
An extremely small, yellow, fuzzy, arachnid-like creature with four small legs and four large, blue, bulbous eyes. It is so tiny it often latches onto larger creatures to feed on static electricity.

A large, tarantula-like creature covered in shaggy, yellow and blue-gray fur. It has four large, jagged horns on its head that store electricity, four blue eyes, and a large, fuzzy abdomen with purple markings.
A floating, spherical seed pod made of dark gray metal. Its body is covered entirely in sharp, green, thorn-like spikes, and it has two narrow, green eyes that peer out from the metallic surface.
A large, metallic, disc-shaped creature covered in thorny vines. It has a central, armored body that clings to surfaces, and it attacks with three long, powerful, thorny vines that it uses as flails.
A creature composed of two small, interlocking, metallic gears. Each gear has a simple face with a single eye (one an 'X', one an 'O') and a small, round mouth. They constantly rotate together.
A creature composed of a large, central gear with a face, which is meshed with a smaller, orbiting gear. A third, outer gear with a sharp, blue spike orbits the main one independently.

A complex assembly of multiple, interconnected, floating gears. It has a large, central gear with a face, a smaller spiked gear, and is all surrounded by a large, red-cored, circular, spiked ring that rotates independently.
A small, white, eel-like creature resembling a single lightning bolt. It has a round, suction-cup-like mouth and a yellow, four-pointed star pattern on its side.
A larger, white, lamprey-like creature. It has a long, eel-like body, a round, suction-cup mouth with sharp teeth, and three yellow, diamond-shaped electricity-generating organs on its side.

A massive, black, eel-like creature with a formidable appearance. It has a long, serpentine body, a powerful, suction-cup mouth filled with sharp teeth, and large, fin-like arms with three yellow, claw-like digits.
A small, green, alien-like creature with a large, bulbous head and a small, slender body. It has large, oval, black-and-red eyes and three colored "buttons" on its chest.
A tall, slender, alien-like humanoid with a huge, elongated, green head. It has a thin, brown body, large, hypnotic, multi-colored eyes, and three brightly colored, finger-like digits on each hand.
A small, ghostly candle. It is a small, white blob of wax with a single, purple flame on its head. It has two large, yellow, dripping eyes and a small, smiling mouth.
A ghostly creature resembling a small, black lantern. A sinister, purple flame burns within its glass casing. It has two glowing, yellow eyes and a curved, hook-like appendage on top.
A large, ghostly chandelier. It has a central, spherical head with glowing, yellow eyes, and several curved, black arms that hold purple, flickering flames. It has a sinister and elegant appearance.
A small, bipedal, draconic creature with a reptilian, grayish-green body. Its most notable feature is the two large, tusk-like blades protruding from the sides of its mouth.
A more robust, bipedal, draconic creature with greenish-yellow, armor-like plates on its body. The tusks on the sides of its mouth have grown larger and sharper.

A massive, bipedal, draconic monster covered in tough, yellowish-green armor plating. It has a fierce expression and two enormous, axe-like blades on the sides of its mouth, which are sharp enough to cut steel.
A small, bipedal, polar-bear-cub-like creature. It is light blue with a darker blue snout, and has a single, large, glistening drop of frozen snot perpetually hanging from its nose.
A massive, bipedal, polar bear with a powerful, intimidating build. Its body is covered in thick, white fur, and it has long, sharp, icicle-like claws and a long, frozen beard of ice shards.
A geometric, snowflake-like creature made of pure ice. It is a large, floating, hexagonal ice crystal with a simple, carved face in the center. It has a chain of ice crystals floating below it.
A small, snail-like creature wearing a gray, round, knight's helmet. Its true body is a small, orange slug with a simple, dopey face.
A slim, agile, ninja-like slug. Its body is a sleek, blue-and-pink creature wearing a gray, ninja-like mask and a scarf made from its own shell's membrane.
A flat, brown-and-tan, fish-like creature that resembles a flounder or a stylized bear trap. It lies flat on the ground, and its face has a vacant, dopey expression with a yellow tail.
A small, bipedal, weasel-like creature with a serious, martial-artist-in-training expression. It has a white and gray body, long arms, and a focused gaze.
A tall, slender, stoat-like creature with a regal, martial-arts-master appearance. It has a purple body and uses its long, pink, fur-like feelers on its arms as powerful whips.
A rough, gargoyle-like dragon with a craggy, dark blue hide. Its head, wings, and skin are jagged and coarse, as if carved from rock. It has menacing red eyes and sharp claws.
A bipedal, clay golem resembling an ancient automaton. It has a dark, clay-like body with light-blue, glowing, spiral patterns on it. A crack on its chest is sealed with a golden, plug-like seal.
A massive, flying, clay golem. It has a cannon-like feature that allows its arms and legs to be retracted, turning its body into a rocket for flight. The glowing, spiral patterns are more prominent.
A small, bipedal, humanoid creature covered in sharp, metallic blades. Its body is mostly red and black, with a helmet-like head that has a yellow, axe-like blade on top.

A tall, slender, humanoid creature fully clad in sharp, metallic, blade-like armor. It has a helmeted head, a massive, sharp blade extending from its chest, and its hands are three-pronged, sharp claws.
A large, powerful, bovine creature resembling an American bison with an afro. It is covered in shaggy, dark brown fur and has a massive, perfectly round, black afro hairstyle on its head.
A small, bipedal, eaglet-like creature with a fluffy, white-feathered head. It has a brown body, large, yellow talons, and a single, long feather protruding from the back of its head.

A massive, bipedal, eagle-like bird with a warrior-like appearance. It has a large, powerful body, and its head is adorned with a large, three-plumed, Native-American-headdress-like crest of red and white feathers.
A small, bipedal, vulture-chick-like creature. It is a pink, featherless bird with a stubby body, a dark gray ruff of downy feathers, and a pink, skull-like bone worn on its lower half like a diaper.

A large, bipedal, female vulture with a devious, witch-like appearance. It has a pink head and neck, a black, shaggy body, and uses a large, heavy bone as a tool or weapon, often adorning its head with it.
A bipedal, anteater-like creature with a red-and-yellow, flame-patterned body. It has a long snout and a tail that acts as a flue, drawing in air to fuel the fire it breathes.
A bipedal, ant-like creature covered in a suit of hard, metallic, silver-colored armor. It has a sleek, robotic appearance, a powerful jaw, and a stern, determined expression.
A small, quadrupedal, draconic creature with a dark blue body and a black, shaggy mane of fur covering its head and neck, obscuring its eyes.
A two-headed, quadrupedal, draconic creature. It has a blue body and two independent, black, furry heads with snarling expressions. It has stubby, purple, wing-like growths on its back.

A massive, three-headed, draconic monster that floats on six small, wing-like appendages. It has a dark blue body, and its three main heads are black with shaggy fur, each with a vicious, menacing expression.
A small, larva-like insectoid with a white, fuzzy body. It has blue eyes and five prominent, orange, horn-like protrusions on its back from which it can shoot fire.
A colossal, moth-like, insectoid deity. It has a huge, black, fuzzy body and three pairs of massive, orange, sun-patterned wings that scatter burning embers when flapped.
A legendary, quadrupedal, stag-like creature with a turquoise body and gray-and-white accents. It has two large, sharp, forward-pointing horns on its head and a determined, noble expression.
A legendary, quadrupedal, bull-like creature with a powerful, stocky build. It has a white body, orange-and-black fur, and two large, sharp, curved horns. Its expression is rugged and unyielding.

A legendary, quadrupedal, equine-like creature with a green-and-white body. It has a large, green, leafy mane, and a single, long, sharp horn on its forehead. It has a mischievous and wild appearance.

A muscular, green, humanoid genie with a cloud for a lower body. In its Incarnate Forme, it has two horns, a spiky white mane, and a long, purple tail with club-like segments. Its Therian Forme is a massive, green, bird-like dragon.

A muscular, blue, humanoid genie with a cloud for a lower body. In its Incarnate Forme, it has a single, large, purple horn, a spiky white mane, and a long, purple tail with spherical segments. Its Therian Forme is a sleek, black, reptilian dragon.

A large, majestic, draconic legendary creature with a pure white, feathered body. It has powerful, fin-like wings, a sleek build, and its tail is a massive, generator-like engine that glows with blue light.

A large, powerful, draconic legendary creature with a sleek, black body. It has massive, tattered, bat-like wings, a powerful build, and its tail is a massive, generator-like turbine that glows with red light.

A muscular, orange, humanoid genie with a cloud for a lower body. In its Incarnate Forme, it has a brown, horned mask, a spiky white mane, and a long, brown, snake-like tail. Its Therian Forme is a large, quadrupedal, feline-like beast.

A massive, draconic, legendary creature with a broken, incomplete appearance. It is a gray, reptilian husk with parts of its body, including one wing and part of its face, seemingly frozen or missing, replaced by crystalline ice.

A quadrupedal, mythical creature resembling a colt or unicorn. It has a light blue body, a large, dark blue mane with three lighter blue plumes, and a single, prominent horn on its head. Its expression is resolute.

A graceful, humanoid, mythical creature with a musical theme. In its Aria Forme, it has long, flowing, green hair and wears a black-and-white dress. In its Pirouette Forme, it has bright, orange-red hair and a tutu-like skirt.
An ancient, bipedal, insectoid mythical creature modified by a cybernetic organization. It has a purple, metallic exoskeleton and a massive, powerful, high-tech cannon attached to its back.
A small, quadrupedal, mammalian creature with a green, shell-like, wooden carapace on its back. Its body is brown, and its head has a leafy green, hood-like cap with a red tuft.
A large, bipedal, mammalian creature encased in a huge, spiky, wood-and-leaf shell. It has a rotund, armadillo-like shape and can curl into a defensive, spiky ball.
A colossal, bipedal, mammalian warrior with a massive, shield-like, wooden shell on its back. It has a powerful, bulky build, and its arms are covered in spiky, green armor.
A small, quadrupedal, fox-like creature with yellow fur. It has two large, fluffy, red-orange tufts of fur protruding from its ears and a fluffy, orange-tipped tail.
A bipedal, fox-like creature with a more elegant, witch-like appearance. Its tail has grown larger and now holds a wooden stick, which it uses like a magic wand.
A tall, elegant, bipedal, fox-like mage. It has a long, flowing, robe-like coat of yellow and red fur, and wields a flaming branch as a magic wand. Its ears are filled with long, fiery fur.
A small, frog-like creature with light blue skin. It has large, yellow eyes and a large, white, cloud-like ruff of sticky bubbles around its neck, which it uses for protection.
A more slender and agile, bipedal frog. It has a sleek, dark blue body and a white, ninja-scarf-like wrap of bubbles around its neck. It has a sly, confident expression.
A tall, slender, bipedal, ninja-like frog. It has a dark blue body, a long, pink, scarf-like tongue wrapped around its neck, and a large, shuriken-like marking on its hip.

A small, bipedal, rabbit-like creature with a gray and brown body. Its most prominent features are its two massive, powerful, ear-like appendages that it uses like extra arms for digging and construction.
A large, bipedal, rabbit-like creature with a powerful, burly build. It has a brown-and-gray body, a thick midsection, and uses its huge, powerful, ear-like arms to lift and throw heavy objects.
A small, avian creature resembling a robin. It has a gray body, a red-orange head and chest, and a long, yellow-tipped tail.
A larger, falcon-like bird with a fiery appearance. Its underbelly is covered in red and yellow, ember-like spots, and it has a sharp, predatory gaze.
A massive, peregrine-falcon-like bird of prey. Its body is streamlined for incredible speed, and its plumage is a mix of fiery orange, red, and dark gray, with flame patterns on its wings.
A small, caterpillar-like larva with a fuzzy, gray body. It has three small, horn-like antennae on its head and a perpetually grumpy or determined expression.
A pupa that resembles a small, white, fuzzy ball hanging from a twig. It is completely covered in a hard, white shell, with only its eyes visible.

A beautiful, butterfly-like Pokémon with large, square-shaped wings. Its wing pattern varies dramatically based on its real-world geographic location, with many different colorful designs (e.g., Icy Snow, Tundra, Modern, etc.).
A small, quadrupedal, lion-cub-like creature. It has a brown body, a large, fluffy, black mane, and a small, red, flame-like tuft of fur on its head. It has a tough and feisty expression.
A massive, bipedal, lion-like creature. The male has a huge, fiery, red-and-yellow mane shaped like the symbol for "fire". The female has a long, flowing, ponytail-like mane of red and yellow hair.
A small, flower-like fairy that clings to the stem of a flower. Its true body is a tiny, white-and-green creature, but it is almost always seen with a Red, Yellow, Orange, Blue, or White Flower.
A slightly larger, fairy-like creature that is now fused with the stem of its flower. It has a green, stem-like lower body and holds its flower like a parasol.
An elegant, humanoid, plant-like creature. Its lower body is a large, bush-like "dress" of leaves, and it holds a massive, ornate, beautiful flower like a staff or scepter.
A small, quadrupedal, goat-like creature with a leafy, green "saddle" and "collar" of fur on its back and neck. It has small, brown horns and a gentle expression.
A large, powerful, quadrupedal goat with a majestic appearance. It has large, curved, brown horns, a shaggy, white coat of fur, and a saddle-like growth of green bushes on its back.
A small, bipedal, panda-cub-like creature with a tough-guy attitude. It has a dark gray and white body and is always seen chewing on a small, green leaf.
A massive, bipedal, panda-like warrior with a dark, intimidating presence. It has a powerful, bulky build and wears a long, tattered, dark gray, cape-like coat of fur.
A quadrupedal, poodle-like Pokémon whose fur can be styled into various cuts (e.g., Heart, Star, Diamond Trim). In its Natural Form, it has a black body covered in thick, puffy, white fur.
A small, bipedal, feline-like creature with a perpetually blank or grumpy expression. It has a psychic appearance, with a gray-and-white body, large, powerful eyes, and folded, ear-like organs.

A bipedal, feline creature with a distinct appearance based on gender. The male is dark blue and white, with a more aggressive, supportive look. The female is white and dark blue, with a more graceful, offensive look. Both have intense, psychic eyes.

A spectral creature that is the ghost of a person slain by a sword. Its physical form is an ancient, tarnished sword with a single, blue, ghostly eye on its hilt. A long, tattered, blue cloth is tied to the pommel.
A creature composed of two, spectral, sentient swords. They are crossed in an "X" shape and held together by a central, shield-like emblem with a single, pink, ghostly eye.

A royal sword and shield. In its Shield Forme, it is a large, ornate, golden shield with a spectral sword sheathed at its back. In its Blade Forme, the sword is unsheathed and held by shadowy, cloth-like arms.
A small, pink, avian-like, fairy creature with a fragrant, perfume-like scent. It has a fluffy, white body, a purple, beak-like mask, and large, red eyes.
A bipedal, fairy-like creature with a can-can dancer or plague doctor appearance. It has a fluffy, pink body, long, black legs, and a dark, pointed, beak-like mask.
A small, bipedal, fairy creature that resembles a sentient dollop of whipped cream. It has a white, puffy body, small, red, cherry-like tufts, and a happy expression.

A bipedal, humanoid, fairy creature that resembles a dessert or a cake-like meringue. It has a large, white, "dress-like" body, a pink, ruffled collar, and is often adorned with strawberry-like decorations.
An aquatic, squid-like creature that floats upside-down. It has a dark, rounded head with a row of pink, light-emitting organs, and several tentacles dangling upwards.
A large, menacing, upside-down squid. It has a sharp, beak-like mouth, hypnotic, glowing patterns on its body, and powerful, fin-like appendages on its head that it uses for propulsion.
A creature composed of two, small, rock-like beings joined together at the side. Each half is a brown, barnacle-like creature with an orange-and-gray, hand-like head with a single eye.

A massive, golem-like creature formed from a large colony of barnacles. Its body is a huge, humanoid shape made of two large, gray boulders for legs and a larger boulder for a torso, with multiple, smaller, hand-like heads.
A small, aquatic creature that resembles a seadragon camouflaged as a piece of rotting, brown kelp. It has a simple, vertical body and a vacant expression.
A large, draconic, leafy-sea-dragon-like creature. Its body is a mix of purple and brown, with large, tattered, kelp-like fins that make it look like a piece of poisonous, floating seaweed.
A small, crustacean-like creature with an asymmetrical design. Its right claw is a massive, cannon-like appendage that is larger than the rest of its blue-and-yellow body.
A massive, bipedal, shrimp-like crustacean. Its most prominent feature is an enormous, rocket-launcher-like claw that covers almost half of its body and can fire powerful blasts of water.

A small, bipedal, lizard-like creature resembling a frilled lizard. It has a tan body and a large, black, collapsible frill around its neck that can open up to reveal a bright yellow, sun-like pattern.
A tall, bipedal, lizard-like creature with a sleek, tan-and-black body. It has two large, expandable, solar-panel-like frills on the sides of its neck, which it opens to absorb sunlight.
A small, bipedal, dinosaur-like creature resurrected from a fossil. It resembles a miniature Tyrannosaurus rex, with a brown body, a huge head and jaw, and a white, fluffy collar of feathers.
A massive, fearsome, Tyrannosaurus rex with a powerful, reddish-brown, scaly body. It has an immense, powerful jaw, and a shaggy, white, beard-like mane of feathers around its neck.
A small, sauropod-like, prehistoric creature resurrected from a fossil. It has a light blue body, two large, sail-like, aurora-patterned fins on its head, and large, gentle, blue eyes.
A massive, majestic, sauropod-like creature with a graceful, blue body. It has a long neck and a huge, wavy, aurora-like membrane that flows from its head down its back.
A quadrupedal, mammalian, fairy-like creature with a graceful, feline appearance. It has a pale cream body and uses several, long, ribbon-like feelers to sense the emotions of others.
A small, bipedal, bird-like, humanoid creature with a luchador or professional wrestler theme. It has a red-and-green, winged body, a mask-like head pattern, and a confident, showy posture.

A small, chubby, rodent-like creature with round, brown ears and a distinctive, antenna-like tuft of fur on its head. It has two pink cheek pouches for storing electricity and a long, lightning-bolt-shaped tail.

A small, floating, fairy-like creature with a body made of a gray, crystalline rock. A large, fluffy, cloud-like ruff of white fur surrounds its head, and it has bright, cyan-blue eyes. A large, pink, diamond-like crystal is embedded in its head.
A small, slug-like creature. Its body is a simple, light purple, amorphous blob with two small, stalk-like antennae and beady black eyes. It's considered one of the weakest Dragon-type Pokémon.
A larger, snail-like creature. Its body is a purple, gooey slug, and its "shell" is a large, translucent, dripping blob of viscous slime. Its eyes are now green and sit on top of its head.

A massive, bipedal, dragon-like creature with a thick, gooey, purple-and-lavender body. It has a very friendly, almost derpy expression. It has two long, retractable, horn-like antennae and a large, powerful tail.
A small, floating creature that resembles a single, sentient, metal key with a pink, poofy, cotton-candy-like top. It has a simple, key-like body and a small, white face.
A small, ghostly creature that is a spirit possessing a rotting, brown tree stump. Its true body is a small, black, shadowy creature with a single, red eye, visible through a knothole in the stump.

A tall, slender, haunted-tree-like creature. Its body is a silvery-white birch tree with gnarled, root-like legs and long, shadowy arms. A single, glowing, red, cyclopean eye stares from a hole in its trunk.
A ghostly creature that is a spirit inhabiting a small, orange pumpkin. Its size can vary greatly. Its upper body is a shadowy, bat-like creature with glowing, yellow eyes and two hair-like arms.

A massive, ghostly pumpkin. Its lower body is a huge, carved, jack-o'-lantern. Its upper body is a dark, shadowy creature with long, flowing, hair-like arms and a single, coiled tuft of "hair" on its head.
A small, quadrupedal creature whose upper body is a sharp, transparent, jagged chunk of ice. Its true body is a small, gray, stone-like head with yellow eyes, visible underneath the ice shell.

A colossal, quadrupedal, creature whose body is a massive, floating, icy aircraft carrier or iceberg. Its back is a flat, cracked, icy plateau, and its lower body is a mass of huge, crystalline icicles.
A small, bat-like creature with a dark gray, spherical, fuzzy body. It has massive, round, speaker-like ears that are larger than its entire body, which it uses to emit powerful sound waves.

A massive, draconic, wyvern-like bat. It has a huge, bulky body, an enormous, gaping mouth, and two massive, speaker-like ears that can generate destructive sonic booms. It has a V-shaped, fluffy ruff on its chest.

A majestic, legendary stag with a powerful, noble presence. In its Neutral Mode, it has black-and-blue fur and massive, multi-colored antlers. In Active Mode, its antlers and body markings glow with bright, rainbow-like light.

A colossal, legendary, wyvern-like creature shaped like the letter "Y". It has a red-and-black body, massive, clawed wings, and a powerful, destructive aura. Its eyes and body markings glow when it attacks.

A massive, serpentine, legendary creature with a long, green-and-black, hexagonal-patterned body. In its 50% Forme, it has a cobra-like head with a frill. In its Complete Forme, it becomes a giant, humanoid mecha with massive, wing-like appendages.

A mythical, fairy-like creature with a gray, rock-like body and a fluffy, white collar. Its head is adorned with a large, beautiful, pink, multi-faceted crystal, and it has a serene, magical presence.

A small, mythical, pixie-like genie that floats in the air. It has a mischievous grin, two small horns, and is often seen with several large, golden rings floating around its body. In its Unbound form, it becomes a massive, six-armed, demonic genie.

A mythical, quadrupedal, automaton-like creature made of gears and steam. It has a large, red, ball-like body, two large, circular, black-and-gold arms, and a powerful, internal steam engine that can create explosive vapor.
A small, avian creature resembling an owl. It is spherical and brown with a white, leaf-patterned face. Two large, green leaves are tied together at its chest, resembling a bow tie.

A larger, more adolescent-looking owl with a proud, almost snobbish demeanor. It has brown and white plumage, and its "hair" is a long, green leaf that it meticulously preens and can throw like a blade.
A tall, humanoid, archer-owl. It has a green, leaf-hooded cape, a powerful, athletic build, and uses a vine from its hood as a bowstring to fire sharp, arrow-like feathers from its wings.
A small, quadrupedal, feline creature with black fur and red stripes. It has a relaxed and aloof personality, with large, yellow eyes and a small tuft of fur on its head.
A bipedal, feline creature with a more muscular build. A fiery, bell-like organ has formed at the base of its neck, which jingles with heat as it moves.
A massive, bipedal, feline wrestler with a powerful, muscular build. It has a dark, intimidating look and a belt of fire around its waist, which it uses to power its fighting moves.

A small, seal-like, aquatic creature with a light blue body. It has a large, pink, clown-like nose that it uses to create and balance water bubbles. It has a frilly, light blue collar around its neck.
A larger, more elegant, feminine, seal-like creature. It has a long, flowing, white body, a graceful posture, and long, blue, pigtail-like ears. It has a developed sense of showmanship.

A majestic, mermaid-like creature with a long, flowing, fish-like tail. It has a beautiful, operatic appearance, with long, white, hair-like appendages adorned with pearls. It controls water with its voice.
A small, woodpecker-like, avian creature with black and white plumage and a prominent, red, mohawk-like crest. It has a sharp, powerful beak that it uses to peck at high speeds.
A larger, woodpecker-like bird with a sleek, black-and-white body. It has a more developed, swept-back, red crest and a look of intense focus in its eyes.

A massive, toucan-like bird with a formidable appearance. Its most striking feature is its enormous, rectangular beak, which can be heated to extreme temperatures, glowing red and orange before firing seeds.
A small, quadrupedal, mongoose-like creature with brown fur. It has a distinctive, yellow tuft of fur on its head that sweeps to one side, and a perpetually determined, scowling expression.

A large, bipedal, mongoose-like creature with a stout, powerful build. It stands on its hind legs with its arms crossed, giving it a detective-like or boss-like appearance. It has a thick coat of brown and cream fur.
A small, grub-like, insectoid larva with a blocky, geometric body. It has a large, yellow, pincer-like jaw and is often found near power plants.
A pupa-like creature that resembles a floating, metallic, rectangular battery or a bullet train. It has a sleek, geometric, white-and-orange body with a single, blue, glowing eye slit.

A large, insectoid creature that resembles a futuristic railgun or a stag beetle. It has a powerful, angular body, with two massive, pincer-like appendages that it charges with electricity before firing energy beams.
A small, crustacean-like creature resembling a yeti crab. It has a purple body and uses two large, blue-and-red, boxing-glove-like pincers to fight. It has a determined, scrappy look.

A large, powerful, yeti-crab-like creature with a massive, asymmetrical build. One of its claws is an enormous, blue, shield-like pincer, while the other is a smaller, purple, punching claw. It has a shaggy, white, fur-like covering.

An avian creature whose appearance changes based on the nectar it sips. Baile Style is a red, fiery flamenco dancer. Pom-Pom Style is a yellow, electric cheerleader. Pa'u Style is a pink, psychic hula dancer. Sensu Style is a purple, ghostly Japanese fan dancer.
A very tiny, fairy-like, gnat-like insectoid. It has a large, round head, a small, black body, and two large, transparent wings. It is covered in a fine, yellow pollen.

A slender, bipedal, fairy-like insectoid with a graceful, bee-like appearance. It has a fuzzy, yellow-and-black-striped body, large, green, compound eyes, and its legs are covered in large, fluffy balls of pollen.
A small, quadrupedal, canine-like creature with light brown fur. It has bright, blue eyes, a fluffy, curved tail, and a collar of jagged, gray rocks around its neck.

A large, quadrupedal wolf. Midday Form is a sleek, brown wolf with a noble appearance and blue eyes. Midnight Form is a menacing, bipedal, dark red werewolf with glowing red eyes. Dusk Form is a quadrupedal, orange wolf with green eyes.
A tiny, lone fish with a sad expression. It is a small, gray-and-blue fish with large, teardrop-marked eyes, giving it a perpetually crying look.

A small, eel-like, aquatic creature that resembles a sea cucumber. Its body is dark with purple, glowing spines. Its most notable feature is its ability to expel its internal organs, which look like a white, fist-like appendage, from its mouth.

A large, monstrous, coral-like creature. It has a dome-shaped, rocky base and twelve long, poisonous, tentacle-like "limbs" that it can retract. Its face is a purple, glowing structure inside the dome.
A small, quadrupedal, donkey-like creature with brown fur. It has large, floppy ears and its body is often covered in a layer of mud.

A massive, bipedal, horse-like creature with a powerful, draft-horse build. Its body is brown, and its lower legs are covered in thick, dark, clumpy mud. It has a black-and-blonde, braided mane and tail.
A small, aquatic, insect-like creature that wears a bubble of water around its head like a diving helmet. It has a small, green-and-brown body with six legs and large, expressive eyes.

A large, spider-like, aquatic insectoid. It has a sleek, green-and-brown body and maintains a large, bubble-like dome of water around its head and torso, which it uses to deliver powerful, headbutt-like attacks.
A small, bipedal, insectoid creature that mimics a flower. It is primarily pink and white, with a green, leaf-like collar and large, sickle-shaped, pink arms.

A tall, elegant, bipedal insectoid resembling an orchid mantis. It has a beautiful, pink-and-white body, with long, slender, green-and-white striped legs. Its arms are large, sharp, pink, scythe-like petals.
A small, mushroom-like creature with a pink, bioluminescent cap. It has a thin, white, stem-like body and large, sleepy eyes. It often gathers in groups and glows in the dark.
A tall, slender, mushroom-like creature with a large, pink cap. It has a lanky, pale body and long, thin, root-like arms and fingers. It emits a hypnotic, glowing light and spores.
A small, bipedal, lizard-like creature with a dark gray body and a purple, belly-and-tail underside. It has a bandit-like mask marking around its large, sleepy eyes.
A large, bipedal, lizard-like creature with a slender, purple-and-black body. It has a confident and cruel demeanor, with a long, powerful tail and the ability to release toxic, corrosive gas.
A small, bipedal, bear-cub-like creature with a pink-and-black body. It has a very cute, cuddly appearance and often flails its arms in a panic, despite possessing great strength.

A massive, bipedal, bear-like creature with a powerful, intimidating build. It has a pink-and-black body, with long, shaggy, white fur on its head and back. It has a fierce expression and incredibly strong arms.
A small, plant-like creature resembling a mangosteen fruit. It has a round, purple body with a thick, green calyx on its head. It has a sweet and innocent appearance.
A bipedal, plant-like creature with a more developed, humanoid shape. It has a green, top-like body, a large, leafy calyx on its head, and a confident, almost tomboyish look.
A tall, elegant, humanoid, plant-like creature with a regal, queenly presence. It has long, powerful, green legs, a purple, fruit-like torso, and a large, crown-like calyx on its head.

A floating, fairy-like creature that resembles a living lei or flower garland. It is a circular chain of green leaves and colorful flowers (pink, red, yellow, and purple) with a small, green, pixie-like face at the top.
A small, bipedal, ape-like creature with white fur. It has large, green, leaf-like "hair" and is often seen holding a large, fan-like leaf that it uses as a command baton.
A bipedal, lemur-like creature with a team-player attitude. It has a white-and-black body and a green, helmet-like growth of fur on its head. It often carries a green, hard berry that it throws.
A small, isopod-like creature with a cowardly nature. It has a purple-and-gray, segmented, armored body, and it often runs away from battles.
A massive, bipedal, samurai-like, giant isopod. It has a formidable, silver-and-purple, armored exoskeleton, a hunched posture, and two massive, sharp, scythe-like claws.
A sentient sandcastle. It is a small pile of sand with a single, small, red shovel sticking out of the top. Its "mouth" and "eyes" are hollowed-out archways in the sand.
A massive, well-formed sandcastle. It has a large, central keep, two smaller towers for arms, and a large, tunnel-like mouth. A red shovel is embedded in its main tower like a flag.
A sea-urchin-like creature with a black, spiky body. Its true face is a small, green, glowing set of eyes that appears in a small opening among its spines when it attacks.
A bizarre, chimeric, creature created from different animal parts. It has a canine-like head with a massive, heavy, metallic helmet, bird-like hind legs, and a fish-like tail.

A majestic, chimeric creature with a griffin-like appearance. It has the head and forelimbs of an eagle and the body and hind limbs of a lion. Its helmet has been shed, revealing a sharp, crested head. It has large, feathered wings.

A celestial, rock-like creature with two forms. In its Meteor Form, it is a heavy, spherical, brown meteor with a rocky shell. In its Core Form, its shell breaks away to reveal a small, brightly colored, floating creature (colors vary).
A koala-like creature that is always asleep. It has gray fur, large, fluffy, orange ears, and a large, black, oval nose. It clings to a large, brown log that it uses as a pillow.
A large, quadrupedal, tortoise-like dragon. Its most prominent feature is a massive, spiky, gray shell on its back that resembles a naval mine. It has a long neck and a powerful, jagged jaw.
A small, bipedal, fairy-like creature with a huge, oversized, disheveled head of blonde and pink hair. It has a tiny, black body, and a perpetually surprised or dazed expression.

A small, ghostly creature disguised as a Pikachu. It wears a crudely made, hand-drawn Pikachu costume with a bent ear and a stick for a tail. Its true, shadowy eyes are visible through two holes in the costume.

A large, piranha-like fish with an extremely colorful, almost garish, body pattern of pink, blue, purple, and yellow. It has a prominent, sharp, horn-like protuberance on its head that glows with psychic power.
A gentle, serpentine, dragon-like creature with a long, white, furry body. It has a large, green, fin-like head crest, and a calm, elderly appearance with a long, green, barbel-like mustache.
A ghostly creature that is a sentient, rusty anchor entwined with haunted, green seaweed. The anchor itself acts as a massive, powerful club, while the seaweed forms a ghostly face and arms.
A small, bipedal, reptilian creature covered in large, metallic, overlapping scales. It has a single, large, heart-shaped, yellow scale on its forehead.
A larger, bipedal, draconic creature with a more developed, warrior-like stance. It is covered in gray and pink, metallic scales and has a large, crest-like array of scales on its head.

A massive, bipedal, draconic warrior covered from head to tail in powerful, metallic, golden scales. It has a majestic and formidable presence, and its tail ends in a large, rattle-like cluster of scales.

A legendary, avian-like, fairy creature with a rooster-like appearance. Its lower body is a purple, bell-like shell, and its upper body is a black, pixie-like creature with a large, red, mohawk-like crest and a colorful, mask-like face.
A legendary, humanoid, lion-like creature with a powerful, masculine appearance. It has a white, muscular body, a face that resembles a sun, and a full, flowing, orange-and-yellow mane.
A legendary, skeletal, bat-like creature with a graceful, feminine appearance. It has a purple, ethereal body, massive, crescent-moon-shaped wings, and a skeletal, mask-like face.
A legendary, pixie-like, fairy creature with a gaseous, nebula-like body. It has a starry, cosmic pattern within its purple and blue form, and a simple, curious, child-like face.
A legendary creature that resembles a floating, golden, celestial cocoon or sarcophagus. It is incredibly dense and immobile, with a starry, cosmic pattern on its golden shell.

A colossal, legendary, lion-like creature made of a white, metallic substance. It has a powerful, majestic build, and its face is a dark, cosmic nebula that glows with the light of a sun. It is a creature of immense light and energy.

A colossal, legendary, bat-like creature with a massive, crescent-shaped, wing structure. Its body is a deep indigo, and its wings resemble a starry, night sky. It is a creature of immense darkness and energy.

A prismatic, crystalline, legendary creature with a black, geometric body. Its arms and head are made of a substance that refracts light, creating rainbow-like glimmers. Its appearance is asymmetrical and alien.
An alien, jellyfish-like creature. Its body is a translucent, bell-shaped, gelatinous mass with long, glass-like tentacles. It has a shimmering, iridescent surface and a vaguely humanoid shape.
An alien, mosquito-like creature with an incredibly muscular, humanoid build. Its body is a bulging, white, muscle-bound form, with small, red, wing-like appendages and a long, sharp proboscis.
An alien, cockroach-like creature with a stunningly beautiful and slender, white, feminine form. It has long, thin legs, two massive, flowing, white antennae, and moves with incredible speed.
An alien creature that resembles a bundle of living, black, electrical cables. The cables have exposed, sparking ends and are writhing together to form a vaguely humanoid or tree-like shape.

A colossal, alien creature that resembles a living, metallic, bamboo-like rocket ship. It has a massive, cone-shaped body, two huge, booster-like arms, and a small, face-like structure on its main body.
A tiny, alien creature that appears to be made of folded, white-and-orange paper. It has a small, humanoid, origami-like body with incredibly sharp, blade-like edges.

A colossal, alien creature with a huge, gaping, spherical mouth that acts as its entire torso. It has a small, secondary head on top, and two massive, pincer-like appendages that it uses to shovel things into its mouth.

A legendary creature whose body is composed of black, crystalline prisms. Its natural form is dark and angular, but it can absorb light to become a brilliant, blindingly bright, golden, draconic being of pure energy.

An artificial, metallic, humanoid creature with a spherical, gear-like body resembling a mechanical dress. It has two large, cannon-like arms, and a prominent, pink-and-red, heart-like core in its chest. Its head has two large, pigtail-like ears.

A small, humanoid, mythical creature made of shadow. It has a gray, child-like body with a helmet-like head made of shadow. When attacking, its head and neck-frill flare up with green and yellow spectral fire.

A small, purple, alien-like creature with a humanoid shape. It has a very large head with a single, long needle on top, and a smaller needle on its tail. Its eyes are large and glow with a cyan light.

A massive, draconic, wasp-like, alien creature. It has a sleek, purple body with two large wings. Its lower body is an enormous, stinger-like abdomen with three additional, smaller stingers protruding from it.

A colossal, alien creature that resembles a living, mobile tower made of stacked, gray, stone-like bricks. Each individual brick has a single, glowing, blue eye on its side, which reveals itself when the creature is active.

A tall, slender, alien creature with a bizarre, clown-like appearance. Its body is white and lanky, and its "head" is a separate, floating, spherical object covered in colorful spots that can explode like a firework.

A bipedal, feline-like, mythical creature with yellow and black fur. It has a sleek, athletic build, long, blue, lightning-bolt-like whiskers, and a long, blue, ribbon-like streamer of fur extending from its back.
A small, creature made of gray, liquid metal. Its head is a single, golden, hexagonal nut with a small, black, spherical eye floating inside. A single, red, wire-like tail extends from its back.

A massive, humanoid golem made of flowing, liquid metal. Its body is incredibly muscular and powerful, with large, golden, hexagonal nuts embedded in its joints and chest. It can spin its arms to deliver devastating punches.
A small, green, monkey-like creature with brown ears and tail. It has a large, leaf-like tuft of hair on its head and carries a small, wooden stick which it taps rhythmically.
A more slender, bipedal, green monkey with a confident, musician-like attitude. It now carries two wooden sticks and has a more stylized, band-like hairdo made of leaves.
A colossal, gorilla-like creature with a powerful, muscular build. It has a massive, tree-stump-like drum set that it carries on its back, and its "hair" is a huge, flowing mane of green leaves.
A small, energetic, bipedal rabbit with white fur. It has long ears with red-orange tips, red-orange feet, and a distinctive, yellow, square-shaped patch on its nose like a bandage.
A slender, humanoid rabbit with a cool, aloof demeanor. Its fur pattern resembles a red-and-gray tracksuit or hoodie, and it often keeps its hands tucked into the fluffy fur around its waist.
A tall, athletic, humanoid rabbit with a soccer-player-like appearance. It has a sleek, white body with red and dark blue fur patterns that resemble a sports uniform. Its build is slender and agile.
A small, timid, lizard-like, aquatic creature with light blue skin. It has a large, yellow, fin-like crest on its head, large, teary eyes, and a curled tail. It can become invisible in water.
A lanky, bipedal, lizard-like creature with a moody, adolescent-like posture. It has a purple-and-blue body, and its "hair" is a slick, wet-looking crest that hangs over one of its eyes.

A very tall, slender, bipedal, chameleon-like creature with a spy or secret agent theme. It has a sleek, blue-and-black body, with yellow and white accents. It can shoot jets of water from its fingertips.
A small, chubby, squirrel-like rodent with gray fur. It has huge, puffy cheeks that it constantly stuffs with berries, and a large, fluffy tail.
A very large, bipedal, squirrel-like rodent with a gluttonous appearance. It has a massive, berry-filled tail that it uses as a seat, and a perpetually stuffed, satisfied look on its face.
A small, round, bird-like creature with blue-and-black plumage. It has a tough, scrappy attitude, with a white, mask-like pattern around its yellow eyes and a sharp, angry-looking crest.
A larger, raven-like bird with a sleek, dark blue-black body. It has a confident, cunning expression and a more pronounced, swept-back crest of feathers.
A massive, raven-like, avian creature covered in black, metallic, armor-like plumage. It has a formidable, knight-like appearance with piercing red eyes and a stern, regal posture.

A small, grub-like insect with a green, segmented body. Its most notable feature is a pair of large, thick, yellow-rimmed glasses that give it a nerdy appearance. It has a small, bow-tie-like marking.
A pupa-like creature with an orange, cone-shaped shell. It has two massive, blue, semi-transparent, dish-like psychic antennae on its head, giving it the appearance of a small, organic satellite.
A large, ladybug-like insectoid that levitates. Its body is small and black, but its head is an enormous, spherical, brain-like orb patterned like a UFO, with large, blue, psychic eyes.
A slender, quadrupedal, fox-like creature with red fur. It has black, glove-like and sock-like markings on its paws, a black, mask-like pattern on its face, and a tail tipped like a thief's sack.
A tall, slender, bipedal fox with a gentleman-thief or rogue-like appearance. It has a sleek body, a black mask, thin, mustache-like whiskers, and a sly, cunning expression.
A small, floating, plant-like creature. Its head is a small, green bud with a massive, yellow, fluffy, dandelion-seed-like puff of pollen on top. It has a cheerful expression.
A small, humanoid, plant-like creature with a massive, fluffy ball of cotton on its head, which it wears like a cap. Its body is small and green, and it has a mature, gentle face.
A small, sheep-like creature with a perfectly spherical body made of thick, white wool. Its face, ears, and legs are black, and it has two small, braided pigtails.
A large, tough-looking, quadrupedal sheep. It has a dark brown body, a thick ruff of white wool, and two large, dark, curved horns. It has a proud and sturdy stance.
A small, turtle-like creature with a large, round, blue head and a single, sharp, yellow horn. Its body is green, and it has a powerful, snapping jaw and a determined expression.
A massive, bipedal, snapping turtle with a rugged, aggressive appearance. It has an enormous, jagged, powerful jaw, an extendable neck, and a heavy, craggy, brown-and-yellow shell.
A small, quadrupedal, corgi-like, canine creature. It has yellow and green fur, a happy expression, and a distinctive, green, heart-shaped patch of fur on its rump.
A sleek, greyhound-like dog with a slender, athletic build designed for speed. It has yellow-and-green fur, and generates electricity as it runs.
A creature that is a single, rolling piece of black coal. It has a single, glowing, red eye and moves by spinning on a small, rocky, wheel-like protrusion at its base.
A creature resembling a mine cart made of rock, filled with a pile of glowing hot coals. The cart forms the body and legs, while the pile of coal on top has two glowing, red eyes.
A colossal, golem-like monster made of black rock and coal. Its back is a massive, smoldering pile of burning coal that acts as a furnace, and it has a powerful, hulking build.
A tiny, green, worm-like, draconic creature that lives inside a red-and-green apple. Only its eyes and two leaf-like antennae are visible, peeking out from the top of the apple.
A small, green, wyvern-like dragon. It uses the shed skin of an apple as a pair of wings and as a tail fin. It has a mischievous and agile appearance.
A stout, quadrupedal, draconic creature whose back is covered by a large, fleshy growth that resembles an apple pie. It has droopy, apple-peel-like ears and a calm, gentle demeanor.
A small, tan-colored, cobra-like snake. It is often seen coiled up in the sand, with its head and a large, expandable, pouch-like hood visible.
A large, cobra-like snake that is perpetually coiled, with its head and neck rising from the center. Its body is a massive, swirling tornado of sand, contained by its tough, patterned skin.
A blue, cormorant-like bird with a vacant, slightly dopey expression. It has a unique ability to scoop up a fish or a Pikachu in its gullet, which it then spits out as a projectile.
A long, slender, brown, fish-like creature resembling a living arrow or torpedo. It has a very simple, streamlined body, a sharp, pointed head, and is built for ramming at high speed.
A massive, powerful, barracuda-like fish. It has an extremely long, streamlined body, a sharp, spear-like jaw, and a propeller-like tail, giving it a menacing and incredibly fast appearance.
A small, bipedal, purple, lizard-like "baby" Pokémon. It has a very grumpy, punk-rock-like expression and a body shape that resembles a toddler wearing a diaper.
A tall, bipedal, punk-rock-lizard. Amped Form is yellow and purple, with guitar-like chest organs. Low Key Form is blue and purple, with bass-like chest organs. Both have a spiky, rebellious look.
A small, flat, insectoid that resembles a fiery centipede or a hot plate. Its body is red and yellow and generates intense heat from its underside.
A massive, fiery centipede with a long, segmented, red-and-orange body. It has a monstrous, flaming face with two large, antennae-like whiskers, and its body glows like a furnace.
A small, octopus-like creature with a tan-and-green body. It has a tough, brawler-like attitude and uses its two front tentacles, which have orange, boxing-glove-like tips, to punch.

A large, blue, octopus-like creature with a wrestler or grappler theme. It has a powerful, muscular build, a masked-fighter-like face, and uses its eight powerful tentacles to constrict its opponents.
