A ghostly creature that is a small, purple, liquid-like spirit possessing an antique teacup. The teacup is white with a blue, floral pattern and a small chip on the rim.
A ghostly, purple spirit that possesses a cracked, antique, ceramic teapot. It can pour its own body out of the spout and has a mischievous, swirling pattern on the pot.
A small, humanoid, fairy-like creature with a pink-and-blue body, almost entirely hidden under a large, droopy, witch-hat-like growth on its head. It has a shy and reclusive nature.
A taller, humanoid creature with a more defined body. It is completely covered by a large, pink-and-blue, tent-like "hat," with two long, hair-like braids that it uses as arms.

A tall, slender, witch-like, fairy creature. Its true, small body resides inside a massive, powerful, tent-like structure made of its own hair, which it uses to attack. It has a silent and imposing presence.
A small, bipedal, fairy-like creature with a mischievous, imp-like appearance. It has a pink body, large ears, a wide, toothy grin, and a perpetually energetic and troublesome attitude.
A lanky, green, goblin-like creature with a hunched posture. Its long, dark hair is sharp and can be used as a spear-like weapon. It has a more menacing and cunning look.

A massive, muscular, ogre-like, humanoid creature. Its entire body is covered in long, dark, hair-like fibers that act as muscles, giving it immense physical strength and a wild, monstrous appearance.
A bipedal, badger-like creature with a black-and-white, punk-rock-band aesthetic. It has a tall, aggressive posture, sharp claws, and is known for its loud, intimidating shouts.
A bipedal, feline-like creature with a wild, Viking-berserker appearance. It has shaggy, gray fur, and its head has hardened into a natural, horned, iron helmet.
The ghostly remains of a Corsola. Its body is a bleached-white, dead coral skeleton. A transparent, ectoplasmic aura surrounds it, with sad, drooping "branches" representing its lost life.
A noble, white, duck-like knight. It has a proud and chivalrous demeanor, and wields a massive, sharpened leek as a lance, along with a shield made of thick, tough leaves.

A bipedal, humanoid creature resembling a classic comedian or tap-dancer. It has a large, round belly with a frozen, face-like pattern on it, wears a block of ice as a hat, and carries a cane made of ice.

A cursed, ancient, rune-covered stone slab that has become a ghost. Its main body is a large, vertical stone with a glowing, red, serpentine eye-like carving. A shadowy, snake-like body holds it aloft.
A tiny, sentient creature made of cream. It is a small, amorphous, white blob with two tiny, dark eyes. It can evolve into many forms depending on how it's treated.
A humanoid creature made entirely of whipped cream. Its form and color vary, but it is typically adorned with sweets like strawberries or clovers. It has a cheerful and sweet appearance.

A creature composed of a coordinated team of six, small, round, brass-helmeted beings that march in a single-file line. They resemble a troop of Spartan warriors, with the one in front being the leader.
A small, spiky, sea-urchin-like creature. Its body is a black, spherical core with many sharp, yellow spines that conduct electricity. It often lies on the seafloor.
A tiny, grub-like, insectoid creature. Its body is a soft, white, conical grub with a translucent, icy shell on its back. It has two small, round, blue eyes.
A large, beautiful moth with a white, furry body. Its most stunning feature is its massive, delicate, ice-crystal-patterned wings that shimmer and shed a chilling dust.
A creature that resembles a walking dolmen or a piece of Stonehenge. Its body is composed of several large, stacked, stone slabs, with two pillar-like legs and a flat top piece.
A penguin-like creature with a large, perfect cube of ice covering its head as a protective helmet. When the ice breaks, its smaller, anxious, purple head is revealed.

A bipedal, humanoid creature with a butler or maid-like appearance. The male is blue-bodied and has upward-curling horns. The female is white-bodied with downward-curling horns. Both have a gentle, supportive look.

A small, rodent-like creature with two modes. In Full Belly Mode, it is a cheerful, yellow-and-black hamster. In Hangry Mode, it becomes a mischievous, purple-and-black hamster with an angry expression.
A small, elephant-like creature made of a copper-like substance. Its body is orange with green, patinated highlights, and it has a powerful, shovel-shaped trunk.
A massive, elephant-like creature with a body of weathered, patinated, copper-like metal. It has a huge, powerful trunk and a stately, ancient appearance.
A bizarre, chimeric, fossil Pokémon. Its top half is a small, green, reptilian dragon, while its bottom half is a large, yellow, lightning-fast lizard's body. The two halves are awkwardly joined.
A chimeric, fossil Pokémon. Its top half is a shivering, blue, icy reptile with a perpetually runny nose, attached to the powerful, yellow, hind legs of an electric creature.
A chimeric, fossil Pokémon. It consists of the powerful head and torso of a green, draconic creature, which is bizarrely attached to the tail end of a large fish.
A chimeric, fossil Pokémon. It has the icy head of a reptile, which is attached upside-down to the body of a fish, giving it a very strange and mismatched appearance.
A bipedal, draconic creature whose body is made of a lightweight but incredibly strong, polished, metallic alloy. It has an angular, almost architectural, design.
A small, ghostly, draconic creature. It consists of a small, green, tadpole-like head and a long, tapering, transparent, ghostly tail. It is very timid.
A ghostly, draconic creature with a large, triangular, stealth-bomber-like head. It carries a small Dreepy on top of its head, which it cares for.
A large, draconic, ghost-like creature with a sleek, stealth-bomber-shaped head. Its most unique feature is two missile-silo-like horns on its head, from which it can launch Dreepy at high speeds.

A legendary, wolf-like creature. In its Hero form, it is a majestic, cyan-and-white wolf. In its Crowned Sword form, it holds a massive, ornate, golden sword in its mouth, and its body is adorned with golden armor.
A legendary, wolf-like creature. In its Hero form, it is a majestic, magenta-and-white wolf. In its Crowned Shield form, its front body and neck are covered by a massive, golden, shield-like mane.
A colossal, skeletal, alien dragon. Its body is an impossibly long, purple-and-red, draconic skeleton. A massive, cage-like structure of ribs in its chest contains a glowing, red, energy core.
A small, bipedal, bear-cub-like creature with a martial arts theme. It has gray fur, a serious expression, and a white, headband-like patch of fur on its head.
A massive, bipedal, martial arts bear. Single Strike Style is dark and powerful, with a fierce, direct stance. Rapid Strike Style is blue and gray, with a more fluid, flowing, multi-hit stance.
A mythical, ape-like creature with a tall, slender, dark-furred body. It has a sinister appearance with piercing green eyes, and can grow and manipulate vines from its body.
A legendary, golem-like creature. Its body is a sphere of pure, yellow, electrical energy, barely contained by several blue, ring-like insulators. Its arms are two jagged bolts of lightning.

A legendary, golem-like creature. Its core is a sphere of dark, draconic energy. Its "arms" are two massive, jaw-like structures made of crystallized red, draconic energy, resembling a dragon's skull.
A legendary, spectral horse made entirely of solid, white ice. It has a powerful, brutish build, a jagged mane of icicles, and an icy, helmet-like mask on its face.
A legendary, spectral horse made of shadowy, ghostly energy. It has a sleek, black body, a mane and hooves of purple, ethereal energy, and a detached, floating tail.
A graceful, bipedal, mythical creature with a small, green, humanoid body and a massive, green, bud-like growth for a head, which houses its immense brain. It has a calm and regal presence.
